de la glo drug mgo yang zer/ de gnyis bsnol te gtar bas glo la rnag khrag 'ong ba dang*/ glo la khrag rgyas ste smug rbab tu song ba dang*/ stod na zhing gzer ba dang*/ nyin gung nam gung la lci zhing dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ glo'i dbugs mi bde ba la phan no// glo ba'i dpung rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis gtar na/ rims las gyur pa'i stod gzer drag po dang*/ glo rtsa khrag gis rgyas te gzer ba dang*/ glo rtsa khrag gis rgyas pa'i skyon gyis 'gram pa g.yas g.yon du gzer ba dang*/ mgo la lha 'thems byung ba la phan no// de'i rgyud gru mo'i khug kyi zur na glo ba'i zur rtsa zhes bya ba yod de/ de gtar na/ glo dang*/ mchin pa dang*/ stod kyi tshad pa dang*/ lag pa sbrid cing na ba dang*/ rtag tu sna khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang*/ glo la khrag mtshal lta bu 'ong ba dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ byang khog la nad phog pa rnams la phan no// mchan 'og nas 'khris nas gru mo'i nang du byung ba de la/ drug mgo chen po zhes bya ste/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa lnga yod/ phyir 'khyug pa ru thung zhes bya ste/ de'i gyes mtshams nas sor bzhi bcal bar gtar na mchin pa khrag gis rgyas pa dang*/ mchin khrag po bar ltung ba dang*/ tsha ba las gyur pa'i rgyu gzer dang*/ mchin pa 'khrugs pa'i skyon gyis mig tshags pa dang*/ 'gram par zug gzer 'ong ba dang*/ rtsib logs gzer zhing mchin dri kha skor na ba dang*/ dug gis mchin pa rgyas pa dang*/ bad kan smug po mchin pa la zhugs te/ khrag rgyas pa la phan no// de nas mar sor brgyad bcal bar gtar na/ dug nad rnying pa la phan no// ru thung gi rtse mo mkhrig ma'i phyi rol long bu'i gdong du gtar na/ ma'i khong du rgyud chad par song nas ma'i rum nas mig tshags pa la phan no// de'i nang ngos su gyes pa'i rtsa de ni mchin pa'i zam pa zhes bya ste/ mchin pa'i nad la phan no// de'i nang gi rtsa de mkhris pa'i gsha' ri'am zhes bya ba yin/

de gtar bas mkhris pa pho bar lud pa dang*/ mig ser ba dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i rims nad dang*/ bal nad mig ser dang*/ mkhris pa'i skyon gyis mgo bo na ba dang*/ mig ser ba dang*/ ling tog gsar pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa'i tshad nad yun ring gis dang ga 'gags pa rnams la phan no// de'i nang ngos kyi rtsa snod kha zhes bya ste/ de gtar na snod kyi tsha ba sel lo// de'i nang du byung ba'i rtsa de ni/ snying gi a so li ga zhes bya ste/ de gtar bas snying rtsa khrag gis khengs pa dang*/ stod lci zhing yi ga mi bde ba dang*/ rims nad snying la zhen pa dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ stod lci zhing nu mchin gzer ba dang*/ snying gi nad thams cad la phan no// de snying gi 'phar rtsa'i sting na gnas pas shin tu gzab bo// a so dang*/ glo'i zur rtsa 'dom pa'i rtsa la gtar na/ glo snying gnyis ka'i nad la phan no// lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i rgyab na rtsa gnyis yod de/ gcig rgyab rtsa drug 'dus zhes bya ste/ de gtar na ro stod rgyas pa dang*/ rgyab tu gzer ba dang*/ khrag ro rnying pa la phan no// de'i phyi ngos rgyab rtsa chen po zhes bya ste/ de gtar bas rgyab smad dang*/ srog 'dab na ba la phan no// de'i phyi ngos rtsa phran yin te/ rgyab rtsa 'khun bu zhes bya ste/ de gtar na mchin pa snyong bu dang*/ mchin pa skyed 'khor gyi nad dang*/ mchin pa klad grangs kyi nad dang*/ ro rgyab 'byar zhing na ba dang*/ mchin pa na ting byed pa dang*/ kha zas yi gar mi 'ong ba la phan no// mtheb mdzub bar na yang mtshon gang bcal ba na glo ba'i skyor gong zhes bya ba yod de/ de gtar na glo ba'i lud pa dmar ba dang*/ gre ba 'dzer ba dang*/ skad 'gags pa'i nad la phan no// mthe bong gi rgyab ngos na/ snying rtsa yod de/ de gtar bas snying gi tsha ba sel lo// mdzub mo'i rgyab na glo rtsa yod de/ de gtar bas gre ba mi bde ba sel lo// gung mo'i rgyab na mtsher pa'i rtsa yod de/

de gtar bas mchu'i bad kan dang*/ mtsher pa'i nad la phan no// srin lag gi rgyab na mkhal rtsa yon po zhes bya ba yod de/ de gtar bas mkhal nad la phan no// mthe'u chung gi rgyab na/ mchin pa'i rtsa yod de/ de gtar bas mchin nad la phan no// thams cad la 'phar rtsa gtar ba gal che'o// lce rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis la gtar na rims nad tsha ba bying ba dang*/ lce skam zhing skom dad che ba dang*/ zas yi gar mi 'ong ba dang*/ bad kan gyi dwangs ma snying gar bros te/ lce mi bde ba la phan no// kha dang*/ lce dang*/ mchu'i nad la yang bad kan gyi rtsa la gtar na phan no// rims nad la dpral ba'i rtsa la gtar na khyad par du phan no// 'khrugs dang*/ rims dang*/ tshad pa snying la shor ba la ol gong gi thog gi snying rtsa 'greng bu la gtar bas phan no// mtheb mdzub kyi bar gyi skyor gong pa'i steng nas/ mkhyid gang bcal bar glo snying 'dom pa'i rtsa la gtar na/ glo skams po 'gog tu mi btub pa dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa rnams la phan no// des stod kyi rtsa che phran gyi gdab pa'i gnas bstan zin to// da ni smad kyi gtar sa bstan par bya ste/ mtsher pa la rtsa sum brgya drug cu yod de/ sbom phra phal cher rta'i rnga ma tsam yod/ de rnams kyang rtsa chen drug tu 'dus te/ stod kyi rtsa thams cad che chung gnyis la 'dus/ rgyal po gtar bas kun la phan zhes bya'o// smad la rtsa thams cad long rtsa gnyis la 'dus te/ de gtar bas long nad kun la phan no// sha lpags kyi rtsa thams cad ngar gdong gnyis kyi mchin dri nas/ g.yas g.yon du yu mo thur du rgyug pa 'dra ba gcig yod de/ ldang ba'i gdong nas mkhyid gang bcal ba'i sa de gnyis gtar na/ mtsher pa 'grams pa dang*/ snad pa dang*/ sbo ba dang*/ mtsher ba la bad kan smug po yod pa dang*/ sha ser ba dang*/ mig ser ba dang*/ mkhris pa gsha' yas thebs pa dang*/ mdze dang*/ shu ba dang*/ g.yen pa dang*/ za kong dang*/

rma dang*/ ser ga sos su mi btub pa dang*/ pus mo'i tshigs dang*/ rkang pa la chu ser 'khor ba dang*/ stod smad du lhung ba dang*/ mkhal ma'i nang dang*/ 'or dang*/ rkang pa'i bol gong skrangs pa dang*/ chu ser gyi nad du gyur pa tsam la rtsa 'di gtar te/ chu ser nag po'i gdong rtsa zhes kyang bya/ mtsher mkhris 'dom pa'i rtsa nag ces kyang bya'o// ngar gdong pa'i mar sna nas sor bzhi bcal ba de/ tshigs kung kung po g.yas g.yon gtar na/ mtsher pa las gyur pa'i nad/ pho ba skabs su 'khru ba dang*/ zas mi len pa la phan no// smad du chu ser rgyas pa la chu ser gyi gdong rtsa dang*/ yob chen gong 'og gtar na phan no// mkhal ma'i rtsa la byin rtsa nag gu g.yas g.yon gnyis dang*/ lag pa'i mthe'u chung*/ mkhris pa'i rtsa gnyis ka gtar/ la la dag byin gzhug zer/ byin pa'i nywa'i dkyil na sbrul 'khyil pa lta bu cig yod de/ rting pa'i dkyil nas mkhyid gang bcal bar gtar/ de'i phyi rol na mar rong bu'i steng na mar byin kyog gtar ro// des rked pa chag pa snyam byed pa dang*/ mkhal khung g.yas g.yon du mchin khrag lud pa dang*/ mkhal ma sur ya dang*/ mkhal ma skyed 'khor gyi nad dang*/ dpyi'i 'khrul dmigs mtshams su zug cing gzer ba dang*/ bud med mngal khrag gis bu mi 'ong ba la phan no// brla'i rtsa bo che ni/ mas yar mtho gang bcal bar gtar ro// sgyid khung pa'i sgab rtsa sor bzhi'i 'og tu gtar te/ des mchin khrag long du 'thums pa dang*/ phyi then skyed sa 'khor gyin 'or du babs pa dang*/ mngal khrag rtag tu 'dzag pa rnams la phan no// rkang pa'i mthil rtsa gtar ba ni/ gnyer ma gsum gyi dbus ma la/ rkang pa'i gung mo nas rting pa'i dkyil du srad bu then pa de bltab par/ gar sleb du gtsag bu sor gcig 'phangs/ khrag dbyung*/ bsku mnye bya/ me btsa' spra rdog gsum gyis bsreg go /khrag ma chod na spyi gtsug gi rtsa la me btsa' gdab bo// des ni snying brdung zhing na ba dang*/

gzer drag po dang*/ gtar ga gzhan gyis ma thub pa dang*/ mgo bo rtsa'i chu ser snying la babs pa la phan no// rkang pa'i rting pa'i dreg mtshams su gtsag kha thur la bstan nas der brdeg steng du spra rdog sran ma tsam gsum gyis bsro/ des mig nad ma lus pa thams cad la phan no// long rtsa g.yas g.yon rus pa'i ther la gdab pas long gi nad dang*/ mkhal rked kyi nad dang*/ mchin pa'i nad thams cad dang*/ zla mtshan rtag tu 'dzag pa rnams la phan no// rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyi bar nas mtshon gang bcal ba'i sar gtsag pu sor phyed dang*/ gnyis 'phangs nas/ ro smad che ba dang*/ grum bu la phan no// mchin pa 'phral du snad pa la ru thung gtar/ mdun na na a so gtar ro// rgyab na na rgyab rtsa gtar ro// rus pa na na mkhal rtsa gtar ro// bud med sbrum ma la long rtsa dang*/ ru thung gtar du mi rung ngo*// a so dang mkhris rtsa gtar ro// mig gi dbang po'i rtsa gnyis/ rna ba'i dbang po'i rtsa gnyis/ snying rtsa gnyis te drug la gtar du mi rung ngo*// rtsa sgo bzhi zhes pa rtse'u chung gnyis dang*/ long rtsa gnyis yin no// rtsa gnyan po bzhi ni snying rtsa gnyis/ brla'i rtsa bo che gnyis yin no// mdor bsdu na/ ro stod na na rtse'u chung gnyis gtar/ nu mchin du zug na a so gnyis gtar/ rgyab tu gzer na glo ba'i sgang rtsa gtar/ rtsib rings 'khris na mchin pa'i ru thung gtar/ rgyu zhabs su gzer na long rtsa gtang*/ rkang pa bshal na byin gzhug gtar ro// gdams ngag 'di ni 'bru bcud kyi nang nas chang dang 'dra'o// gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ gtar ga'i man ngag zug rngu phyir 'dren zhes bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so// //bla ma rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// me btsa'i gdams ngag rin po che'i thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di la lnga ste/ rgyab dang*/

mdun dang*/ sta zur yan lag go /de yang rlung gis khrag 'khyags nas na ba'i me btsa' dmigs su bsregs pas rlung khrag dros nas zhi bar 'gyur ro// dmigs la gnyis/ nad kyi gsang btsal ba ni/ sha khol bur na ba dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ chu ser gyi 'or dang*/ rtsa'i sgo dang*/ mnan na mi bzod pa dang*/ mnan na rjes 'ongs pa dang*/ gang na na ba'i sar bsreg go /spra rdog che chung dang*/ grangs mang nyung ni/ mi'i khams dang*/ nad kyi bye brag dang*/ don snod kyi sha sra snyi dang*/ don snying gi sha sra snyi dang*/ rtsa rgyus kyi bye brag dang sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa gang gi nad btsal ba ni/ spyir du ma cig yod kyang*/ mgo la gdab pa'i gnas ni/ spyi gtsug gnam rten dang*/ mdzod spu mtshog ma/ dpral ba'i skra mtshams/ kha 'gram g.yas g.yon/ kos ko'i 'og gi kung kung po dang*/ ske'i rtsa gnyis/ rna ba'i mdun gyi 'phar rtsa gnyis rnams so// rgyab kyi an chen stong rus/ rlung gi gsang*/ gnyis pa mkhris pa'i gsang*/ gsum pa bad kan gyi gsang*/ bzhi pa glo ba'i gsang*/ lnga pa glo ba ma'i gsang*/ drug pa srog pa rtsa'i gsang*/ bdun pa snying gi gsang*/ brgyad pa mchin dri'i gsang*/ dgu pa mchin pa'i gsang*/ bcu pa mkhris pa'i gsang*/ bcu gcig pa mtsher pa'i gsang*/ bcu gnyis pa pho ba'i gsang*/ bcu gsum pa bsam se'u'i gsang*/ bcu bzhi pa mkhal ma'i gsang*/ bco lnga pa glo long 'dres pa'i gsang*/ bcu drug pa long gi gsang*/ bcu bdun pa rgyu ma'i gsang*/ bco brgyad pa lgang ba'i gsang*/ bcu dgu pa dang nyi shu ba rlung gi gsang*/ rtsa gcig pa gzhang gi gsang*/ rtsa gnyis pa mjug to'o// thams cad la kha gsum du yod do// mdun gyi gdab sa ni/ ske'i tong tong po dang*/ de nas thur du mtshon gang du gdab pa'o// de nas thur du mtshon phyed dang do bcal bar bsreg go /de nas thur du mtshon gang bcal bar kha gsum du gdab/ de nas yang thur du mtshon phyed dang do bcal ba'i g.yas g.yon du mtshon lngar gdab/

lte ba khung gi g.yas g.yon mtshon re phun rer gdab/ de nas thur du mtshon gang bcal ba'i g.yas g.yon du mtshon gang phun gang du gdab bo// de nas thur la mtshon gang du kha gsum du gdab bo// zur gyi dmigs ni/ mchan khung gi spu gseb tu gdab na glo'i rnag 'chad do// nu ma gnyis kyi rtse mo nas thur du mtshon bzhi bcal bar gdab/ tshigs pa bzhi pa nas g.yon du mkhyid gang bcal ba mkhal ma'i phug yin no// rkang pa'i dmigs ni langs nas gung mos sleb pa'i brla'i phyi sul dang*/ lha nga nas sor bzhi dang*/ pus mo'i tshigs gnyis dang*/ sgyid khung pa nas mtshon bzhi thur du bcal ba dang*/ long bu'i nang ngos nas gyen la sor bzhi 'jal ba dang*/ rting pa'i dkar nag mtshams nas dang*/ mthe bong dang*/ mdzub mo'i bar nas yar mtshon gang bcal ba'o// lag pa'i dmigs ni/ lag pa bteg pa'i dpung pa'i gshol dang*/ sog pa gnyis kyi dkyil dang*/ gru mo gnyis dang*/ pus mo gnyis bkug pa'i mtshams kyi sna bzhir gdab bo// mdor na rlung nad kyi so mtshams na/ rna ba'i 'og gi shor bu ldad mtshams su bsreg kha so na/ mig mi gsal ba sdud sgo bsreg mgo 'thoms nas sna khung na na/ spyi gtsug dang mchog gnas la gdab bo// mjug tsha ba goms pa'i tshe/ tshigs pa bco lnga pa la me btsa' byas kyang btub/ srubs bsreg kha so/ yob la g.yas su yo na/ g.yon gyi ldad mtshams bsreg g.yon du yo na g.yas bsreg spyir rlung nad chen po yod pa dang*/ rigs chen po la an tong rus bsreg tshigs pa bzhi man chad bsreg na phan/ snying gi nad la tshigs pa gnyis pa bsreg mchin dri la brgyad pa/ mchin pa la dgu pa/ mkhris pa la bcu pa/ mtsher pa la bcu gcig pa bsreg go /pho ba'i nad la bcu gnyis pa dang*/ mkhal ma'i nad grang rlung gi nad/ yang grang rlung gis chu 'gags pa rnams la bcu gsum pa dang bcu bzhi pa bsreg glo ba dang long 'dres pa'i nad/ rtsa rgyun 'gags pa la bco lnga pa/

rtag tu sa bon 'dzag pa dang*/ lus zungs zad pa la bcu drug pa bsreg lus kyi smad sbo ba dang*/ gom pa mi brtan pa dang rkang pa rengs pa la bco brgyad pa dang*/ bcu dgu pa dang*/ nyi shu pa gsum bsreg go /bad kan gyi nad la lhen sna bar mtshon gang bcal bar kha gsum du bsreg go /de rnams ni mdor bsdus pa'i man ngag go /me btsa' byas nas gom pa bdun tsam bcag de'i nub mo chu mi btung*/ gnod pa'i zas bsrung*/ bsreg tu mi rung ba'i tshigs pa bcu pa yin/ mig gi 'bras bu gnyis/ pho mo'i rtag gnyis/ pho'i tshigs pa bcu drug pa/ mo'i gnyer ma ring po gnyis/ mig gi rtsa/ chu ba las byed pa spong ngo*// legs pa'i tshad bya thi ba'i mdog 'dra ba dang*/ chu ser cung zad 'byung ba dang*/ chu bur 'phred na 'byung na nad myur du 'tsho'o// me btsa' rin chen thigs pa'o// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// bshal gyi gdams ngag rin po che'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum mo// sbyor ba ni/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ lus dal ba dang*/ mi 'khyags pa dang*/ gnyid bde bar log pa dang*/ dugs bya ba dang*/ rus pa dang*/ bshul la bsku mnye bya ba/ nad la mi gnod tsam du lto chas bya// bsnyung bar 'dug go /nang par gtang ba'i nub mo// snum bag zos na snum 'dred du 'gro'o// sngon 'gro ma byas par bshal btang ba ni/ dper na shing skam po 'gugs pa dang 'dra'o// dngos gzhi ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gdan la bzhugs pa'i sbyong zhes bya ste/ bcos ka gzhan gyis ma phan pa dang*/ khong pa ldem pa dang*/ rkang lag sbrid pa dang*/ rtse chung rengs shing gzer pa la phan no// dan da bzhi/ lcum rtsa mthe bong tsam gcig dur byid mthe bong tsam gcig zangs rtsi ba bye sgong gang*/ rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig zhib par btags la bu ram dang sbyar la gtang ngo*// mi rgod kyi rgyun sbyor zhes bya ste/

srin nad dang*/ ma zhu ba dang*/ pho ba'i lcags dreg dang*/ zas zos mngal du zhugs pa dang*/ na ba la phan no// shu dag ril ma tsam gcig dur byid mthe bong tsam gcig zangs rtsi ba bye sgong gang*/ pi pi ling gsum/ se rgod kyi bar shun bye sgong gang*/ rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig bur chu la btab la gtang ngo*// mgron po lam du zhugs pa'i sbyong zhes bya ste/ gzer nad dang*/ mtsher ba'i nad dang*/ lci zhing brang tshab dang*/ tshigs pa khol zhing na ba thams cad la phan no// dbyi mong zho phyed/ shi ri khaṇ+ḍa rdog po gcig khron bu mthe bong tsam gcig gur gum thun gcig gu gul dkar po bye sgong gang*/ tsha ba gsum thun re re/ de rnams chang ngam chu skol la sbyar la gtang ngo*// rgyal po chibs gong gi bshal zhes bya ste/ mgo na ba dang*/ pho ba na ba dang*/ bad kan glo mig tu shor ba dang*/ chu ser pags pa'i nad dang*/ long gi nad thams cad la phan no// rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig lig dur thun gcig a ru ra mchu snyung gcig sngon bu bye sgong gang*/ ba sbru ba mthe bong tsam gcig lcam pa'i 'bras bu thun gcig de rnams zhib par btags la chu skol la gtang ngo*// rma rnying gi red bshal zhes bya ste/ rma rnying*/ mchin nad bshul pa la zhen pa dang*/ dug nad rnying pas 'byang du mi btub pa dang*/ rkang lag lhu tshigs na ba thams cad la phan no// stag sha ba bye sgong gang*/ cu gang thun gcig rgya tsha zho gang*/ gu gul dkar po thun gcig shi ri khaṇ+ḍa thun gcig sug smel thun gcig de rnams bu ram dang sbyar la gtang*/ byis pa'i 'jam bshal zhes bya ste/ bu chung gi nad 'byang du ma btub pa dang*/ mchin pa snyong bu dang*/ bu chung gi nad skye ru ma 'dod pa dang*/ res na res drag byed pa la/ 'di ni man ngag khyad par can mchog tu gyur ba yin no// kha ru tsha ril ma tsam gcig dang ga 'phang lo tsam gcig star bu zho gang*/ sga zho gcig brag zhun thun gcig sgron shing ril ma tsam gcig

zhib par btags la mar dkar la lde gu byas la gtang ngo*// drag po 'dus pa'i sbyong zhes bya ste/ nad gzhi che ba dang*/ smad gzhan gyis 'byung du ma btub pa dang*/ rlung mkhres bad kan 'khrugs pa dang*/ mchin nad grum bu dang*/ skran nad dang*/ mdze dang*/ chu ser gyi nad thams cad la phan no// bser bu bag tsam yang mi rung ngo*// dan da bzhi/ dur byid mthe bong tsam gcig khron bu mthe bong tsam/ sngon bu bye sgong gang*/ shi ri khaṇ+ḍa ril ma tsam gcig dong ga 'phang lo tsam gcig zhib bar btags la bu ram dang sbyar nas btang na nad gzhi thams cad la phan no// btsun mo pang na bu thogs kyi bshal zhes bya ste/ pho ba na ba dang*/ rgyu long gi nad thams cad dang*/ bud med kyi tsha ba'i nad thams cad dang*/ bu snod grang nas bu mi chags pa dang*/ smad du nad zhugs pa thams cad la phan no// kha ru tsha ril ma tsam gcig cu gang thun gcig a ru ra mchu snyung gcig gur gum thun gcig se rgod bar shun bye sgong gang*/ de rnams chu phul gang tsam la bsdus la/ nang par lto stong la gtang ngo*// des mo nad thams cad la phan no// rkang rjen dang*/ bser bu mi rung ngo*// skran gyi gcod bshal zhes bya ste/ skran gsar pa dang*/ pho ba lcags dreg dang*/ ma zhu ba dang*/ dmu chu dang*/ bad kan dang*/ rims thams cad dang*/ sbyong gzhan gyis ma phan pa dang*/ 'khrugs rnying pa la phan no// dan da bzhi/ shu dag ril ma tsam gcig dbyi mong zho phyed/ rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig stag sha ba bye sgong gang*/ kha ru tsha ril ma tsam gcig zhib par btags la bu ram dang sbyar la gtang*/ rkang rjen bag tsam yang mi rung ngo*// glo'i 'khrul bshal zhes bya ste/ glo ba la khrag dang rnag 'ong ba dang*/ ro stong tsha ba rgyas pa dang*/ glo mchin dang*/ mkhris pa'i nad 'byang du ma btub pa dang*/ tsha ba'i nad thams cad la phan no// lcum rtsa mthe bong tsam gcig dur byid mthe bong tsam gcig shi ri khaṇ+ḍa rdog po gcig

li ga dur thun gcig cu gang thun gcig star bu thun gcig ka ra'am/ sbrang rtsi dang sbyar la gtang*/ nyi ma la sdod du mi 'dod do// pho ba'i drod bshal zhes bya ste/ pho ba na ba dang*/ ma zhu ba dang*/ skran dang*/ lus kyi sha chung du song ba dang*/ bad kan rgyas pa dang*/ mkhal rked kyi nad la phan no// ya ba k+ṣar thun gcig zangs rtsi ba bye sgong gang*/ khron bu mthe bong tsam gcig a ru ra mchu snyung gcig rgya tsha zho gcig sga zho gcig zhib par brdungs la chu skol gyis phul la gtang ngo*// de la se ru dang*/ rkang rjen bag tsam yang mi rung ngo*// mchin pa'i khrag bshal zhes bya ste/ mchin pa'i nad dang*/ khrag nad rnying pa dang*/ tsha ba 'or du lhung ba dang*/ mig tshags pa dang*/ mig la bad kan dang*/ khrag rgyas pa dang*/ rkang lag gi tshigs na ba la phan no// mtshal zho gcig pi pi ling gsum/ sngon du bye sgong gang*/ gur gum/ brag zhun/ gu gul dkar po gsum thun re re/ ba sha ka thun gcig gi thang la bskyon la gtang ngo*// chu ser gyi 'dren bshal zhes bya ste/ chu ser dang chu shor gyi nad thams cad dang*/ ma zhu ba'i nad thams cad dang*/ kha gdong dang*/ rkang lag skrangs pa dang*/ lus po rengs pa dang*/ pho ba skrangs pa thams cad la phan no/ rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig se rgod kyi bar shun bye sgong gang*/ gu gul dkar po bye sgong gang*/ ba sbru ba mthe bong tsam gcig shi ri khaṇ+ḍa ril ma tsam gcig zhib par btags la bu ram dang sbyar la gtang ngo*// mkhal ma'i drod bshal zhes bya ste/ rtsa 'khrugs kyis rkang pa mi bzod par na ba dang*/ dri ma sdom zhing rgyu smad rnams grims shing chu sri ba la phan no// a ru ra mchu snyung gcig rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig tsha ba gsum thun re re/ lcam pa'i 'bras bu sug smel gnyis thun re/ dong ga 'phang lo tsam gcig zhib par btags la chang ngam/ chu bskol ba'am/ bu ram la sbyar la ril bu byas la gtang ngo*// shed che ba rnams la/

sman rnams thun che bar gtang*/ shed 'bring po la/ thang bshal la sogs dpyad la gtang ngo*// shed chung ba rnams la bshal sman mang du sbyar la gtang ngo*// rlung shas che ba rnams la/ sman snum pa dang*/ drod che ba dang*/ lan tshwa gtang ngo*// mkhris pa che ba rnams la sman kha ba dang*/ mngar ba gtang ngo*// bad kan che ba rnams la tsha ba dang skyur ba dang rtsub pa gtang ngo*// gtang ba'i thabs ni/ dug dang*/ glang thabs dang*/ glo bur ba rnams la mi rgod kyi rgyug bshal zhes bya ste/ dus dang sngon 'gro mi dgos/ lto stong tsam la gtang ngo*// skyugs na mtshog ma nas mnan/ dbugs bsdam mo// stong mid bya/ byad la kha phru btab/ glo phugs su ma shor bar bya/ lus po dro ru byibs so// pho bar 'dril nas ma phigs na yos dugs bya/ mar phags na/ yang ma nu'i thang gtang*/ chu skol gtang*/ rus khu gtang ngo*// 'khru ba'i bar la lus po grang du mi gzhug bad kan be'u snabs lta bu 'khru ba na bcad ren/ 'khru ba'i grangs/ rab bcu drug 'bring bcu gsum/ tha ma bcu 'khrus pas chog go /smad bshal la bad kan smug po'i mtsho rdol ba ngan/ 'khru ba drags na bad mkhris zad nas chu skya bo'am/ sha btsos pa'i khu ba lta bu'am/ chu ser ram tshil bu 'dra ba 'ong na/ mig phugs su 'bros so// bcad pa'i dus ni rlung skye ba'am/ shes pa 'phyo ba'am/ skra can nam/ snum can nam/ dri ma snom pa'am/ shin tu grangs mang ba bcad de/ lug sha skam po'am/ ba glang gi sha tshil bu ma yin pa'i tsho khu/ phye dang*/ cha med pa dang*/ shin tu gdus pa khyor gang gtang ngo*// gnyan thog tu gnyan phebs pa ni/ tsha ba 'byams pa yin pas rtsam pa dang*/ zho btsos pa la bag phye btab la gtang*/ da trig zho dang sbyar la gtang*/ long rtsa gtar ro// rlung gis 'byams na/ sha chen dang bu ram gtang*/ lus la bsku mnye bya/ be'u snabs su 'khru ba'am/ bad kan gyi mtsho rdol ba'am/ skyugs na ma nu'i thang gtang*/ skom du star bu'i thang gtang*/

chu skol gtang*/ tshigs pa brgyad pa dang bcu bdun pa/ lte ba nas mtshon gang bcal ba'i sar bsreg nad ma phyin na/ bshal yang yang bskyar ro// bshal rjes bsrung ba ni/ rtsa chu dang bstun la/ zas skom nad dang 'phrod pa gtang*/ gzugs po grang du mi gzhug go /drag shul mi bya/ lham gon la bcag pho mo'i 'du 'phrod spong*/ grang ba'i nad la bshal gtang dgos pa ni/ snod du bad kan grang ba zhugs pa dang*/ dmu chu dang*/ grang ba'i nad 'ong dang*/ skran dang*/ lhen dang*/ bu snod du grang ba zhugs pa dang*/ grang ba rnying pa rnams so// bshal gyis nad gdon pa ni gos dri ma can 'khrud pa dang 'dra/ 'dir ni bshal rigs mi 'dra ba bcu bzhi bstan te/ 'khor lor byas na khras mig gi lugs yin no// gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ bshal gyi man ngag rin po che'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba'i le'u'o// chos rje sa skya'i gdams pa/ sa māp+ta mi thi// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// stod skyugs 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di la/ nad kyi rigs ni bad kan gyis pho ba na ba dang*/ zas mi 'ju bar lhem me na ba dang*/ mchin khrag pho bar lud pa dang*/ ro stong rgyangs shing na ba dang*/ zas yi gar mi 'ong bar kha kha ba dang*/ bad kan glo mig tu 'tshang nas glo lu zhing gyen la 'gro mi nus pa dang*/ lhen sna nas pho stod kyi nad la gtang bar bya ste/ de la sngon 'gro lto chas bya/ rus pa dang*/ bshul bal yang bsku mnye bya/ nang par gtang ba'i mtshan mo sngar gang gnod pa'i zas bsten/ bkra shis gsol lo// dngos gzhi ni/ pi pi ling bdun btang ste/ des zug 'joms so// dur byid mthe bong tsam gcig des sman tshigs thams cad 'khrud/ po so 'chas gyen la 'dren par byed/ lcam pa'i 'bras bu tshum gcig kha mi skom par gyis/ sbyang tsher rtsa bas 'khrud par byed/ shu dag ril ma tsam gyis nad kyi sra ba thams cad gcod/

rgyam tsha mthe bong tsam gcig gis rtsam pa 'dzin/ sum cu tig gis tsha ba 'joms so// khyad par du mkhris nad la gser gyi phud bu bdun gtang*/ rta ni ba'i 'o ma bzhos ma thag la btab pa phyed gtang*/ nad dang cung zad 'thab tu gzhug yang zan gcig bza' ran na phyed gtang*/ 'thab yun ring na sman gtor nyen yod pas skyugs pa 'dra na lan gcig bzlogs te de nas gtang*/ skyugs snying mi 'dod par mi skyugs/ skyugs na mi dga'/ skyugs su mi 'dod par dang gar 'khyil nas mchil ma mang na/ bya'i sgros gre ba ma snad bar brad la skyug go /cung zad thogs pa la ru rta dang*/ rgya tsha ril ma tsam re byis pa lo brgyad pa'i chu la sbyar la gtang*/ des 'dod tshad skyugs par byed do// yang na dug mo nyung dang*/ po so 'cha'i 'bras bu gnyis rting la btang bas kyang lcag tu 'gyur ro// ma phigs pa'am/ nad ma phyin pa'am/ zug che ba'am/ rlung skyes na bskyar la gtang ngo*// dang po bad kan skyugs/ bar du mkhris pa/ tha ma rlung gi tshul du sbu bar skyugs na legs/ grangs ni lan brgyad skyugs na bzang*/ 'bring drug bzhi skyugs na tha ma'o// stod skyugs la/ smad srin byung na ngan no// skyugs pa 'chad du ma 'dod na/ snying gar chu lcags brdegs/ grang dugs bya'o// bad kan smug po skyugs na btsod dang 'u su'i thang gtang*/ rlung gis skyugs na/ cho khu khyor gang gtang*/ zan dron cig gtang*/ chang gsar bu khyor gang gtang ngo*// zho dkrugs khyor gang yang gtang ngo*// zas ma zhu ba dang*/ lhen dang*/ skran dang*/ snying dang*/ lkog ma na 'phar ba dang*/ mkhris pa'i rigs tsam la phan no// yang ri sho ba'i rtsa ba dus su brkos pa rtsi bzhin du btags la/ bye sgong gang btang na nad kyi rnam pa des kyang 'dren no// yang sag ram rtsi sha ba'i ril ma tsam gcig gla rtsi/ shu dag gsum btang na/ des kyang nad kyi rnam pa 'dren no// gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/

stod skyugs 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes ba'i le'u rdzogs so// //ni ru ha 'dren pa'i 'khor lo ni/ gal te rtsa 'gags pa'am/ pho ba 'gyings pa'am/ bshal thogs pa'am/ pho ba dang*/ rgyu ma'i nad 'byin par byed pa yin/ dur byid/ bul tog dud pa/ lcum rtsa/ a ru ra/ tshwa/ sug pa rnams rtsi bzhin du btags la sings po dang sbyar/ 'o drod tsam bsrol la 'bru mar kyu gang blugs la/ grod par blugs pa gce'u tshad ldan bcug ste skud pas bkyigs la nad pa sngas dmad la 'phongs bstod de grod pa'i dbugs bton la rtse mo la mar bskus te/ gce'u 'phongs su sor bzhi ga le ma snad par gzhug gce'u'i kha gzhang gi logs la rdugs te/ 'gro ru ma 'dod na gce'u steng 'og g.yas g.yon du kha gcus la btang ste brod pa'i sman btsir la btang la lhag ma cung zad cig rlung yod pas mi gtang bar bzhag la gce'u bton la 'phongs ras mas bkag 'phongs la thal lcag lan bzhi lnga zhig brdeg de nas rkang pa'i mthe bo che gnyis nas bzung la gnam du bteg gin bsigs/ de nas gzhogs g.yon 'og tu bcug la nyal mi thub pa 'chor ba 'dra na/ lan gnyis sam gsum du bzlog de nas bzlog drags na la rgal 'gro srid pas sla nga la sogs su btang*/ skyo 'dur gong bu cho le byung na thebs/ chu zangs rkyang du byung na ma thebs pas smad kyi nad thams cad 'dren pa'i mchog yang bskyar la gtang*/ sman ro 'don phyir rgyam tsha'i chu skol gtang*/ zhag gcig lto bskyungs pas smad kyi nad thams cad 'dren pa'i mchog yin no// ni ru ha 'dren pa'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba sa māp+ta mi thi// //sna bshal 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba ni/ nam tshang yan chad kyi nad sel ba yin te/ dpral ba la yos dugs bya/ mgo la mar bsku/ snabs skam po phyis la/ rlung med pa'i sar 'phongs bstod/ sngas cung zad smad la gan rkyal du nyal/ des ltag pa dgyes byas la/ sman khu sna ru blugs la rngub tu gzhug

de yang gce'u kha phra mo sor drug par blugs la phus gdab bo// sman ni gser gyi me tog dang*/ so ma ra dza dang*/ thal ka rdo rje dang*/ yung ba dang*/ sug pa dang*/ pi pi ling dang*/ tsha la dang skyer pa'i rtsa ba rnams/ ra'i 'o ma'am dri chu la sbyar la gtang*/ de lta bu nyi ma lnga tsam gtang ngo*// gal te brgyal na brang dang gdong pa la chu lcag brdeg go /de nas chu skol gyis kha bshal la gsur dud gtang*/ des ni mgo bo'i nad dang*/ mig tshad dang*/ khyad par du tsha ba mig la bros pa dang*/ sna bug cing sna nas chu ser 'dzag pa'i nad sel bar byed do// 'dis ni dper na chang sbu gu nas 'dren pa dang 'dra'o// sna bshal 'gugs pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so// sa māp+ta mi thi// //'jam rtsi bdud rtsi sel byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ gzhang lug pa dang*/ smad la drod 'chad pa dang*/ mkhal ma 'or du lhung ba la gtang ngo*// sngon 'gro lus po brdal/ lto chas bya/ spyod lam gzabs/ dugs dang bsku mnye bya/ bshang gci bde bar bsal/ chu dron gyis khrus bya'o// sman ni mar srang gnyis pa tsag bcad la/ a 'bras sra 'bras 'jam 'bras gsum/ sug smel lcam pa srin bu gsum/ rgya tsha rgyam tsha kha ru tsha gsum/ dgu po zhib par byas la mar la gdab/ mar 'jam pa la pho ba'i nang du blugs la/ pho ba'i khar gce'u chung bcug la/ skud pas sor bzhi'i mtshams su bkyigs/ sor bzhi nang du btang la glo ba brkyangs pa bzhin bya'o// de nas bal lam 'phying pas 'phang dgag nad pa g.yas 'og tu bcug la zur la nyal du gzhug gan rkyal du mi nyal/ sngas smad/ skabs su btsag rjes bshal dang 'dra'o// phan pa 'dra na yang zla ba phyed tsam na gtang*/ des khong ba 'jam zhing snum par byed do// 'jam rtsi bdud rtsi 'phel byed kyi le'u'o// sa māp+ta mi thi// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa lto sbrag ma'i bshal gyi man ngag la/

sngon du tshigs pa dang*/ yan lag la bsku mnye bya/ chu skol sum yar gtang*/ de nub gtang ba'i srod la lcam pa'i thang gtang*/ lto snum bag tu btang na snum 'dred du 'gro bas mi gtang*/ de'i nub mo lto dgug go /sman sbyar ba ni/ dur byid mtheb tshigs tsam gcig khron bu de'i phyir/ a ru ra rdog po che ba gcig rgyam tsha dum gcig pi pi ling rdog ma bdun/ de rnams ji ltar zhib ba ltar du/ bshal rgyug mgyogs so// de ni lto bshal gyi man ngag khyad par can no// de'i steng du rtsa bshal gyi man ngag la/ byang ba mgo lus tshang ba dug bton pa lnga'am bdun/ lcam pa'i 'bras bu tshum gcig rgya tsha ril ma tsam gcig mtshal ril ma 'bring po tsam gcig de rnams sbyar ba ni/ dang por mtshal zhib par btags/ de nas gzhan rnams btags la chu la sbyar la gtang*/ nad pa lus tsog pur 'dug la rkang pa brkyang du mi gzhug skyugs na kha phru dang*/ phu yis gdab/ des dang po lto 'khru/ de nas rtsa nas 'khru ste/ sngon la dri chu mang po 'byung ste/ de nas dri ma dang*/ ljan ljin 'byung*/ de nas chu ser dang khrag 'byung*/ khrag thigs pa re la zug shin tu che bar 'byung ste/ 'jigs par mi bya/ khrag shas 'gags na rdo rje mnye/ smad du na na yos dugs bya/ zungs khrag dmar la dngas par byung na gcad par bya ste/ dom mkhris chu grang la sbyar la gtang*/ mar khu bzhu ba gtang bas 'bol gyis 'gro/ rjes la sha tshil bu med pa'i tsho khu btang*/ zan dron khu tshur tsam gcig gtang*/ de nas lto cha yis bskyed/ nad pa nyog gis song nas zas mi za na/ rus pa bcud can brdungs pa'i khu ba btang*/ des sangs kyis 'gro/ nad pa bsku mnye byas la cung zad bcag rlung dang*/ ser bu dang*/ rkang rjen bag tsam yang mi rung*/ skom bag med mi btung*/ lto yang ga ler sbyang*/ 'dis ni rtsa nad dang*/ 'bras dang*/ nad rnying pa zhen pa thams cad la phan par 'gyur ro// rtsa lto sbrag ma'i bshal gyi gdams pa sa māp+ta mi thi//

//oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces bya ba 'di la/ dang po rims bsrung ba'i gdams ngag ni/ rgyu rnam par rtog pa yin pas sems bskyed/ rnam rtog gi 'khri ba gcod pa yin pas sngags dang rdzas la nan tan bskyed de/ gla rtsi dang*/ shu dag rgya snag sum sbyar te/ gzungs 'di bri/ tad+ya thā/ a li/ ma ta li/ ha la ha/ che ge mo la/ dz+wa ran/ tsan dha li/ a ka ha hi ti/ kan te hi/ kan tsa du ga tha gu ni/ ad+ya swā hā/ zhes pa rang gis bris na legs/ 'dri mkhan ma langs par dril la mgul du gdags/ zla ba gsum nas spos na legs so// rims nad thams cad dang*/ khyad par du gag lhog rgyu gzer thub/ phyugs nad thams cad kyang thub bo// 'di la the tshom ma byed/ shin tu zab bo i thi// //mgo la srin rigs gnyis yod de/ ya ma dkar po dang*/ ya ma nag po'o// dkar po ni mgo byed na/ ldang dub tu yod de/ de la skra bzhar la byi tang ga dang*/ shing kun zho re re/ bag phye zho dang sbyar la mgo la khyab par byugs/ ras kyis rgya chings byas la zhag lnga bzhag de'i bar la khrag gam/ chu ser cig rna ba nas 'byung*/ ma byung na rna ltag pa'i kung kung po spra ba lngas bsreg go /ya ma nag po ni mgo thams cad la zug gzer ldang ste snying mi thub/ lus 'dar/ yan lag mi tshugs so// de la spyi gtsug dang mtshog sgo bsreg rtse chung gnyis gtar/ dpung rtsa gnyis gtar/ snying rlung gi dpyad la tshigs pa drug pa dang snying rtsa gnyis bsreg 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar gtang*/ snying rtsa gnyis gtar na phan no// //klad pa rgya 'khrugs pa'i dpyad ni/ skra sangs kyis bzhar la/ bag phye dang zho/ sbang ma'i gar po// sgo nga rnams sbyar la skra mtshams yan chad khyab par byug ras kyis rgya chings byas la bsdams/ sna nas khrag dang chu ser byung na thub/ ma byung na sna bshal btang ngo*// thod rtsa gnyis gtar bas phan no// mkhris pa mal nas shor nas skyugs pa la tshigs pa bcu gnyis pa spra ba gcig gis bsreg

mtshog sgor spra rdog bdun gyis bsreg go /des phan nges so// mig la ling tog byung ba la/ mig dmar na mchin pa la khrag lud pa yin pas/ tshigs pa dgu pa bsreg bshal drag po byas na phan no// mig skya na rlung dang bad kan skya bo'i nad yod pas/ tshigs pa dgu pa la spra ba bzhag ba spu 'khyil pa'i rlung dmigs su spra rdog bdun bzhag mig dmar la tshags na/ mtsher pa la khrag lud pa yin pas/ lag pa'i srin lag gi mtsher rtsa khug pa gnyis gtar na phan/ mig skam tshags su song na/ mur gong gi 'khyug rtsa gnyis gtar la/ rma khar spra rdog gsum gyis gdab/ mig ser po mthong ba sel snying 'dod na/ mkhris pa lhags pa yin pas/ rkang pa'i mthe bong na mkhris rtsa ru 'du bya ba yod de/ de gtar na thub bo// yang mig la glo bur du rdo dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ mtshon la sogs pas bzher ba dang*/ snad pa dang*/ btsan pa la sogs pa la/ pha 'ong gi dreg pa dkar po dang*/ khye'u nu 'thung gi nu zho dang sbyar la byug nang du blugs/ pug shud mig sman zhes bya ste nges par 'tsho'o// mig la skya rib kyis nag po lang long gis khebs na/ a ru ra gser mdog chu la brdar la/ sga skya/ yung bas mdog 'gyur tsam byas la/ bag phur la thigs re thigs gnyis blugs la/ lug re bsha' yun tsam du nyal la/ de'i rjes la chu gtsang gis bkru'o// yang 'di yin med par mthong byed nyams nas re re la gnyis gnyis su mthong ba dang*/ nag po lang long byung na/ a ru ra/ skyu ru ra/ lcags phye/ pi pi ling*/ shing mngar rnams sman mar gyi tshul du sbyar la/ rtswa a pa/ gur gum/ ka ra/ sbrang rtsi rnams kha tshar btab la bsten na phan no// de ma 'byor na/ a ba/ go snyod/ gur gum/ khyim bya'i bya thal rnams gtang ngo*// yang mig 'phel 'grib byed pa la/ phag tshil/ go snyod/ 'bri mar rnams rkang mthil la byugs na phan no// //sna khrag 'dzag pa'i dpyad la/ klad pa nas 'ong na/ khrag mdog skya la ser te/

smin mtshams su spra rdog lngas bsreg spyi bo'i rtsa rnams gtar bas phan no// rtsa nas 'ong na khrag gi mdog dmar por 'ong bas/ ske'i 'bog mtshams su rtse'u chung gnyis la spra ba lnga lngas bsreg nad pa la gzhu lan gsum 'gengs su gzhug rkang mthil du shing leb sos brdabs pas phan no// sgrel bzhi nas 'ong na/ khrag mdog nag por 'ong bas/ de la pho'i rlig pa dang*/ mo'i nu rdog dam par bcing*/ ro stod la chu lcag brdegs/ grang dugs bya'o// //rna ba sgra che la 'ur na/ mkhal ma la rlung zhugs pa yin pas/ de la rting pa nas sor gnyis bcal bar/ thur ma rus pa la thug par 'phangs la/ rma kha spra rdog bdun gyis bsregs na phan no// rna ba tsha 'on du song na/ mkhal ma'i khrag lhags pa yin pas/ lag pa'i mthe'u chung gi mkhal rtsa'i khug pa gnyis gtar/ rna ba'i bu ga rngab rus gzhibs na phan no// rna ba nas rnag 'dzag ste 'on pa la/ rna rtsa sbu gu can gnyis/ spra ba bdun bdun gyis bsregs na phan no// //glo la khrag tu 'ong ba ni/ glo rtsa chad pa'am/ 'grams pa'i skyon yin pas/ sog pa'i me long gnyis spra rdog bdun bdun gyis bsregs na phan no// ro stod rlung gis gang ste na ba la/ glo rtsa gnyis gtar/ tshigs pa lnga bsregs na phan no// //mchin pa da rgan du song na/ tshigs pa brgyad pa dang dgu pa 'bur te 'ong*/ de ni mchin pa tshigs pa la 'byar nas yod pa yin te/ de la dang po bya bra'i lums drag po bya/ lums nas bton nas/ gyen nam skas la khur chen po khur na phan/ des ma phan na/ khur mi 'tsham pa cig bkur la/ khur po de mis bteg la gyen du bltas te gzhu 'gengs su gzhug go /khengs pa dang*/ mis bteg pa btang na/ mchin pa dang*/ tshigs pa bye nas 'gro'o/ glo da rgan du song na/ glo ba dang tshigs pa 'byar na skam pa yin te/ de la chang mang po btang la bzi ru gzhug zangs chus bkang la/ mes bskol te/ de'i kha phub kyis bcad de/

sgal tshigs phub la gtad la gan skyal du bzhag nas ji tsam bzod bzod du bzhag ma bzod na bzhag la/ gzhu 'gengs su gzhug rkyal pa bus pa cig ma tshor bar rgyab nas lan gsum brgyab na/ glo dang tshigs pa bye na 'gro'o// snying da rgan du song ste/ snying la chu shor bas/ snying tshil tshigs pa la 'byar na rkyal pa bzhi bus la/ sa stengs shod du byas la rkyal pa skas them bzhin du byas la/ rkyal ba'i 'og tu dong chus bkang ba byas la/ nad pa drag shul du khris pas/ rkyal ba la 'dred nas chur lhung ba dang*/ snying tshil dang sgal tshigs 'bral lo// chu ser rtsa la gram nas 'gro bas/ ol gong gi 'phar rtsa gnyis la spra ba gsum gsum gyis bsreg go /mkhal ma'i nad kyis ltag pa dgye bor song na/ mkhal rtsa nag po'i tshigs pa bco lnga pa nas nyer gcig pa'i mchan na gnas pas/ de gnyis bsregs na phan no// mkhal ma'i rtsa 'grams na byin gzhug gtar la rma kha spra ba bdun gyis bsreg go /dpyi mig gnyis bsreg go /tshigs pa bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bcu drug pa gnyis bsregs na phan no// mtsher pa la tsha ba skyes nas/ skyugs bro nas zas mi 'dod na/ bar gdong gi mtsher rtsa gtar/ lag pa'i srin lag gi tshigs pa'i bar gnyis bsregs na phan no/ rtsa nag bsregs na yang phan no// mtsher pa grangs te skyigs bu 'ong ba la/ mtshog sgo spra ba lngas bsregs na phan no// mtsher pa tsha ba'i skyon gyis sbu bar skyugs na/ pus mo nas mar sor bzhi bcal bar bsregs pas phan no// tshigs pa bcu gsum pa la spra ba bco lnga bzhag na phan no// ma zhu ba'i rigs gsar rnying thams cad la bshal gyis sbyangs na phan no// pho khar spra ba brgyad kyis bsregs na phan no// pho ba rlung gis gang ba la/ 'jam rtsi lan lnga'am bdun gtang*/ tshigs pa brgyad pa dang bcu gsum pa bsreg go /rgyu zhabs su khrag skran byung na/ tsha sna drug khong du btang la khrus drag po byas na phan no// lgang pa skrangs pa la tshigs pa nyi shu pa'i g.yas g.yon mtshon re bcal bar spra ba bdun bdun bzhag na phan no// lgang pa'i nang na rmen bu yod pa de la/

rmen gung mo'i khar blangs la thur ma brdeg de gnyis nas rtsa 'khrus drag po gtang ngo*// lgang pa'i nang na rde'u yod pa la/ gung mo'i thor tos rde'u blangs la thur ma bsregs pa rgyab pas phyed mar btang la/ de nas skra bsregs pa'i thal ba dang*/ skyes pa'i sa bon dang rgya tsha bye sgong gang*/ byis pa lo brgyad pa'i chu la sbyar nas btang na/ rde'u phyed mar thon te myur du sos so// chu rlung gis srin tshigs pa brgyad pa kha gsum du bsregs na phan no// mkhal ma zho sha dang*/ ka ka ru'i sman mar sbyar na phan no// chu khrag gis sri ba la/ nang 'dra gnyis gtar la/ a 'bras dang 'jam 'bras sra 'bras gsum sdig srin rnams chu grang la sbyar nas btang na phan/ rgyu zhabs su dugs drag po byas na yang phan no// tshad pas khrag tu 'khru ba la/ khye'u lo brgyad pa'i chu la/ ka ra dang zho btsos pa 'o ma la btab nas btang na phan no// tshad pas ser por 'khru na/ lcum rtsa dang*/ dur byid/ shi ri khaṇ+ḍa/ chu grang la btab nas btang na phan no// be'u snabs su 'khru ba la/ tha ram pa dang*/ da trig zho la btab nas btang na phan no// bad kan skya rbab tu song ba la/ gdong rtsa yu mo thur du rgyug pa dang 'dra ba de gnyis bcad na chu 'byung ste/ skya rbab 'phral du sos so// chu skems pa la/ mi thod skam po/ lci ba ser ka ma/ dbyi mong skam po dang gsum bsregs pa'i thal ba/ ya ba k+ṣar/ dngul thal/ zangs thal/ lcags thal/ gser/ mu zi/ de rnams zhib par btags la/ dar tshags nas gdon/ de nas tsha ba gsum dang sbyar nas btang na 'phral du sos so// srin na dra de ni/ mtshog ma/ mur 'gram dang so la zug nas na na/ rtsi bo che/ sgog skya/ dha du ra nag po/ sga/ de rnams sha ba'i tshil bu la sbyar/ sla ngar chu blugs la g.yom ba'i steng du/ 'khar gang bsregs la bzhag la/ de la sman ril ma tsam re bsregs la kha bcad de du ba ma shor bar byas la mal chas byibs/ lan gsum bya'o// des ma phan na/

srin lag gi thor to spra ba gsum gyis bsregs na phan no// sna khrag yun ring du 'dzag na skya rbab tu 'gro nyen yod pas/ gur gum/ tsan+dan/ mar rnying la sbyar nas bdugs na phan nges so// snying la rlung zhugs nas sprugs pa la rkang pa gnyis kyi mtheb snying la spra ba lnga lnga bsregs na phan no// 'brum bu nag po ni mtsher ma la mkhris pa lud pa yin pas/ rtsub khrus drag po btang na phan no// dmar po ni mchin pa la khrag lud pa yin pas/ rtse chung gnyis/ mchin rtsa gnyis/ snying rtsa gnyis/ nang 'dra gnyis/ nyin re la gnyis gnyis gtar bas thub bo// dkar po ni/ glo ba la bad kan dkar po lud pa yin pas/ ba sha ka ra sha/ ra khrag rlon pa dang*/ dron mo btang na thub bo// sna cham la ka ra dang*/ rgya spos sbyar te sna nas bdugs na cis kyang thub bo// glo cham la/ a krong dang*/ 'dam bu ka ra khye'u lo brgyad pa'i chu la sbyar nas 'thungs na myur du sos so// bu chung sham ma thon pa la/ ri bong ril ma bdun/ rgya ru dum gcig khyim bya'i brun dkar po/ rtsangs pa'i sha rgya tsha/ 'ol ma se/ se ldo ba tshum gcig khyi'i 'bras bu rnams zhib tu btags la chang la btab nas khong du gtang*/ rgyu zhabs nas smad du dugs bya/ bre'i zhabs la mtshal gyis yi ge nya gcig bris la mig blta ru gzhug go /mi thon mi srid do// gzhang dang bu snod lug na 'o ma 'jam pos bkrus la/ sbar sbur dang*/ sa dang*/ dri ma med par byas te/ drod phab la mar dang til mar byug rkang pa la thag pa btags la 'then/ de la dbyug pa brgyab pas tshud par 'gyur ro// yang na lag pa'i sen mo bregs la dag par bkrus la mar gyis byug gzhang dang bu snod kyang byugs la/ lag pas gzhang dang bu snod rang slong du gzhug tshud pa dang*/ 'phongs dang*/ mo mtshan la phying pa la mar gyis byugs la bsros la glan/ rdo'am/ slu gu bsregs la bdug go /so srin gyis zos pa'i og phor du bong nga nag po bcug nas spra tshil gyis kha bcad na phan no// chu ma thon nas 'gags na skra shad bsregs pa'i tshigs ma khyor phyed tsam chu skyogs phyed kyi nang du blugs la gtang ngo*// des phan no// mje'i bu gar btsong btsugs te bus na phan no// yang na sbur pa nag po slang ru brngos te/

shun pa nag po skyur la nang gi dkar po mar dang sbyar nas btang na phan no// khyi rngo'i sman la sho mong gi rtsa ba brdungs la/ mar dang brdzis te lus la byugs nas nyi ma la gdung*/ de lta bu lan gnyis gsum byas na phan no// rna ba nas rnag 'dzag pa la ra rog po'i chu'i nang du rgya tsha lug shig tsam bcug la/ 'jam bsros la rna bar blugs te cung zad bzhag la dbo/ rnag rul sbyang ba'o// de nas rtsa ba'i lnga'i sman mar sbyar la btang la/ zhun mar dang bcud bzang du bsten/ chang skyur spangs/ rna ba'i nang du lug shig dang rtswa shig song na/ chang ngam zho skyur mo blugs na phan no// mdzer pa'i dpyad la lam rgya gram gyis blangs la zla ba nya ba'i dus su sa des phyis/ rang gi dri chus bkrus na phan no// yang na spang spos zhib tu btags nas/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma dang*/ ba'i chus lde gu byas la/ srod la nyal khar lag pa bkrus la bsku/ de me la bsros la bskams pa dang*/ lag pa rang gi phur la bzhag nang par lag pa mi bkru/ de'i nub mo yang sngar bzhin bya/ de'i nang par lag pa dag par bkrus la/ de la tshwa bskus la ba lang la bldag tu gzhug go /de lta bu lan gsum byas na mdzer pa thams cad la phan no// bud med bu dbyung bar dka' na khong du mar khu slud/ lto ba pags pa rlon pas dkri/ mi cig gis phrag pa g.yas g.yon na btsir na phan no// yang bud med bu med pa la/ ba'i 'o ma dang*/ rta'i 'o ma dang*/ bud med kyi 'o ma cha mnyam la bsres la dkrogs pa'i mar de ra'i 'o mar bskol te bkru sman dang sbyar te 'thungs na mngal rdo rje bzhin brtan te bu chags par 'gyur ro// skrangs pa'i rigs tsam la steng du bag zan gyi ra ba 'phang lo tsam byas la/ de'i nang g.yer ma phye mas dgang*/ de'i steng du bag zan leb mas dgab la/ de'i steng du me btsa' gdab/ khong du tsha ba tshor na mod la phan no// //bud med zla mtshan ma chod na/ rkang pa'i long bu'i nang gi rtsa la spra rdog gsum bzhag

des chod par 'gyur ro// yang rgya skyegs dang*/ dom mkhris sbyar nas btang na phan no// //sna khrag ma chod na/ dung dang 'gron bu 'dra ste/ bsregs pa'i thal ba chang la sbyar nas 'thungs na phan no// yang na pho'i rlig pa dang*/ mo'i nu rdogs bcings na phan no// zab chen gyi dud pa sna ru bdugs na phan no// rma khrag mchod pa la rta spangs kyi phye ma rma khar glan te bsdams na phan no// mi'i dri chen sla ngar bsregs nas zhib par btags la rma khar glan na phan no// dom mkhris/ gur gum/ ka ra gsum rgya skyegs khu bas phul nas btang na bad kan smug po byer ba sdud pa'i mchog yin no// dbyi mong lo ma gcig tshugs su gtang ba'i yon tan ni/ dmu rdzing*/ 'or du skrangs pa/ lto ba na ba/ zas mi 'ju ba/ rtug skam kyis btab pa/ gcin 'gags pa dang*/ da rgan dang mkhal rked na ba la phan te/ thun tshod zhor/ khye sus la chang dang sbyar nas gtang*/ lan bdun nam dgu la sogs pa nyams dang sbyar la gtang*/ dang po sbyar ba'i thabs ni/ dbyi mong lo ma bre gang tsam de bskams la/ dge slong gi dri chus bangs tsam du sbangs la yang bskams la zhib par btags so// de nas kha ru tsha chu la sbyar bas bangs tsam du btab la/ de yang de ma thag tu bskams la btags so// kyi lce ba'i me tog dang*/ lo ma brdungs pa'i khu ba btsir la/ skyogs bcu tsam bskol/ gang tsam du song ba de/ nyi ma la bskams la/ de'i ril bu nas tsam de zos pa'i yon tan ni/ rims gsar bu dang*/ tsha ba'i rims/ rus pa la rims zhugs pa la phan no// lto ba sra ba snyi bar byed do// yang zangs rtsi ba'i lo ma rlon pa'i khu ba/ kyi lce ba'i thabs bzhin byas te/ ril bu btang na chu ser dmar po las gyur pa'i rims nad thams cad la phan no// lto ba snyi bar byed do// so phag rnying pa bsdus pa'i thang gtang na/ kha lce dang gre ba skam pa sel lo// spang rgyan dkar po dang*/ shing mngar gnyis bsdus la/

cu gang*/ ka ra btab la/ cung zad ngad yal ba la btang na/ gre ba'i nad thams cad sel lo// ma nu/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ sle tres/ sga bzhi thang du bskol nas btang na khrag nad thams cad dang*/ khyad par gzer nad thams cad la phan no// skyu ru ra'i tshig thang gis khrag ngan pa dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i mchog yin no// li ga dur bskol ba'i thang la/ cu gang*/ gur gur/ ka ra btab nas btang na glo'i tshad nad sel lo// li ga dur dang*/ gla sgang gnyis rgyu dang nus pa gcig yin te/ glo ba'i nad la chig thang gis thub bo// mchin sman tshi gu/ gur gum gnyis/ thang ngam yang na mar dang sbyar te btang na mchin pa rgud pa'i nad sel bar byed do// a ru ra dang*/ rgyam tsha/ sga'am pi pi ling sbyar nas thang du btang na grang ba'i nad sel lo// khyad par du ma zhu ba sel lo// se 'bru/ shing tsha/ sug smel/ pi pi ling*/ cha bsnyams la/ ka ra bzhi 'gyur dang sbyar nas btang na bad rlung thams cad sel lo// lhag par nad gzhi gang yin kyang dang ga 'byed pa'i mchog yin no// btsod/ la phug nā ga puṣ+pa/ nā ga ge sar/ pi pi ling*/ sga rnams cha bsnyams la zhib par btags nas ka ra bzhi 'gyur dang sbyar na/ bad kan sel te/ khyad par du skyugs pa'i nad sel lo// shing kun dang*/ sga gnyis zhib tu bsdus la kha ru tsha kha tshar btab nas btang na snying rlung sel lo// a sho kan dha/ lca ba/ ra mo shag a ru ra/ ba ru ra/ sga rnams bsres la/ khu ba 'don/ lan gsum mam/ dgu la sogs pa ci rigs par gdon/ de'i khu ba dang*/ mar dang*/ 'o ma chu ma chod kyi bar du gdu'o// pho ba zhan na sman tshigs gdon/ pho ba bzang na sman tshigs mar dang bsres pa tsam las chu mi bcad/ de gang yang rung ste/ kha 'khyags tsam la sug smel/ sle tres/ pi pi ling*/ rgyam tsha/ sbrang dang bu ram btab la legs par dkrugs te btang na rlung dang*/ chu ser 'dres pa'i nad sel lo// khyad par du tshabs kyi nad sel lo// smad du grang ba skyes pa la/

lte ba man chad nas/ rkang pa'i thil yan chad dang*/ rtsa sbubs dang*/ chu sbubs kyi nye 'khor du snum gyis zhen par bsku mnye bya'o// khyad par du tshang ra'i tel tel po la drag tu bya'o// dugs bya ba ni/ rdo leb dang*/ so phag tshos par bsregs la chu btab la gos kyis g.yogs te/ bur dkar mthe bong tsam gcig gzhug go /sbubs dang*/ tshang ra dang*/ rkang mthil dang*/ rgyu zhabs su yun ring du bdug go /gos dro bar bya/ dugs kyi rjes la grang du mi gzhug go /yang na sbang ma skam po la chang gis kha phru gdab pa'i nang du rdo'am so phag bcug la bya/ yang na phying pa'am/ re ba snum gyis bskus pas gtums la bya'o// reng bu ni lcum rtsa dang*/ bul tog dud pa/ po so 'cha'/ a ru ra/ pi pi ling*/ rgyam tsha rnams btags la mar dang bsres te/ reng bu mthe bong gi dbyibs 'dra ba byas la/ mas yar btang na des lto sbos ba dang*/ phyi sa 'gags pa dang*/ chu sri ba/ bad kan gyi skran/ rlung skran be'u rnabs 'khyags pa/ rlung nad thams cad dang*/ khong srin dang*/ grang nad thams cad sel lo// dri ma dang rlung legs par rgyu bar byed cing*/ rlung rang rang gi gnas su 'jog par byed do// reng bu btang nas kyang dugs yun ring du bya'o// tsi tra ka a ru ra/ rgyam tsha rnams cha bsnyams nas zhib par byas la chu skol la skyo mar byas nas 'thungs na/ pho ba'i me drod skyed pa dang*/ ma zhu ba sel ba dang*/ skran 'joms pa dang*/ yi ga 'byed par byed do// yang a ru ra dang*/ pi pi ling*/ rgya tsha gsum cha bsnyams pa'i phye mas ni drod skyes pa dang*/ yi ga 'byed cing skran 'joms/ ma zhu ba sel lo// tsha ba gsum dang*/ rgyam tsha/ kha ru tsha/ cha bsnyams/ bu ram cung che bar byas pa'i phye mas glang thabs thams cad sel lo// khong pa 'khrog cing na na/ nas zan gyi bya bra dang*/ tsha bag tsam cig cong zhi phye ma tshum gcig chu bre phyed la gdus la gtang*/ rdo rje'i brag kyang 'jig go

/bud med kyi bu lto bar shi na/ bya go bo'i gre ba dang*/ rgya ru sbyar la gtang ngo*// ro smad ches ma theg na/ byi sa phul bzhi/ lug gi ril ma phul bzhi/ phug ron gyi ril ma phul bzhi/ phabs rnams chang gis bran la tshos par btsos/ sgye'u'i nang du blugs la yun ring du bdug lan gsum bzhi bar du bya'o// rlig pa'i 'bras bu skrangs na/ tshigs pa bcu bzhi'i gsang bsreg des thub bo// phob gzer nas na na/ chu skol gtang*/ dugs bya'o// phyi sa 'gags na sug pa'i phye ma mar dang bsres nas 'phongs na yar bcug na/ da lta rang du sangs kyis 'gro'o// gre bar rus pa zugs nas ma thon na/ sha rnying dum bu rgyud pas khong nas brgyus la mid du gzhug gre bar song ba dang yar 'then no// des thon nges so// bud med bu btsas pa'i rjes la/ khrag ma thub na/ 'om bu'i dud pas 'dom nas bdugs na phan no// srad bu phra mos nywa bzhi bkyigs na phan no// gre ba bcos thabs la/ spang rgyan dkar po'am/ sngon po gang rnyed dang*/ shin mngar dang*/ ka ra/ cu gang rnams bsres la gdus te lto stong la phul gang gtang*/ gre ba 'gags pa kun la phan te/ skad dril bu 'dra bar 'gyur ro// snying la tshad pa zhugs na/ lce dkyil nag por 'ong ste/ rtse chung dang*/ a so li ka gtar/ bsil sman gtang ngo*// snying la nad grang ba zhugs na/ rdul mong po 'don/ rus pa'i sman mar phan no// bud med bu rogs ma thon pa la/ glum bzang po mnyes pa cig la/ sga rdog lnga dang*/ ka ra rdog gcig mnyes te/ phul do khye'u sus la btang na phan no// khyo'i skra shad bsregs pa'i gzhob btab ste/ chang dang sbyar nas btang na phan no// des ma thon na/ rta drag shul byas pa'i rta stan dron mo bkab la/ lcag gis brab na phan no// lce chung dmar la yar rkan smug na lce chung tsha ba babs pa yin te/ spyi bo'i rtsa rnams gtar na phan no// rkan dang lce chung skya na grang ba babs pa yin te/

spyi bo'i rtsa rnams la me btsa' bzhag na phan no// bzang drug gi steng na ga pur bsnan nas ka ra drug 'gyur dang sbyar nas btang na tshad nad sel lo// a ru ra/ tsha ba gsum/ bu ram la sbyar nas btang na grang ba'i nad thams cad sel lo// ma nu bzhi'i steng du tig ta bsnan te btang na khrag dang khyad par du stod gzer la phan no// ma nu dang 'bras bu gsum bskol nas btang na/ rlung mkhris 'dres pa'i nad la phan no// ma nu/ sle tres/ pi pi ling dang gsum 'o mar bskol te/ lto stong la btang na rlung las gyur pa'i rims nad sel lo// gur gum/ cu gang*/ brag zhun gsum cha bsnyams la bskol te btang na/ mchin pa'i nad sel lo// sga/ kha ru tsha/ tsab ru tsha/ shing kun rnams bskol nas btang na/ grang ba'i nad dang rgas nad sel lo// se 'bru/ sga/ rgyam tsha bskol nas btang na/ bad kan gyi nad sel lo// ma nu/ tig ta/ gla sgang*/ kyi lce ba rnams bskol nas btang na/ mkhris pa'i nad thams cad sel lo// skyigs bu rgyun ma chad par byung na/ snying khud du spra ba gsum bsregs na phan no// li shi /gla rtsi'i chus 'brum pa'i nad la mchog tu bsngags/ ra sha dang po nas gtang*/ ra'i khrag btang na phan/ 'brum bu mig la byung na/ 'ol ma se'i 'bras bu btags la bud med kyi nu zho la sbyar la byugs/ 'bri mog dang*/ dre'u'i tshil bus byugs pas rjes mi 'ong ngo*// 'brum nag gre bar byung nas 'thams na/ byi tsher ba'i rtsa ba skog pa skyur la/ nang gi de btags nas chu grang la sbyar nas btang na rdol nas med par 'gro'o// spyir 'brum nag byung ba la/ 'di'i chu thigs re khong par btang bas chog go /sa māp+ta mi thi// //gre ba'i skya thor la/ a ru ra gser mdog shu dag nag po/ sga smug po gsum cha bsnyams la/ mthongs na yod na sbu gus bud/ mig gis mi mthong na gri rtse gang chu la btab la gtang*/ rlung thub tshad gcig bsdams la/ de nas hag byas pas/

ro sbur thon nas 'ong ngo*// 'di sla la phan yon che ba yin no// sga/ lo btsan/ rgyam tsha/ dud pa/ rgya mtsho gser gyi bye ma rnams sbyar la/ ril bu gsum mam bdun btang la mal chas gtibs/ ma drag bar la chu mi btung ngo*// des pho log gi rigs gang la yang phan no// chu'i char pa'am/ grang ba'am/ sbos pa la/ rdo srin can cho lo tsam gcig sla ngar blugs pa la/ der chang bsings blugs la bslags/ chang rdo la thim pa dang*/ sgye phad ser mor blugs la mkhal ma thog nas bdug go /sbos pa zhi bar 'gyur ro// the tshom med/ mig tshags pa la ti tsa dmar po zhib par btags te/ ka ra dang*/ mar dang sbyar te bskus na zhag gsum na 'tsho'o// mig la ling tog byung na/ mi rus lci skam la bsregs la/ des blangs na lon no// sna khrag ma chod na/ zan dpral bar bsnyad la rtse mo la be'u'i lci ba bskus te me la bsros nas them bu ltar dgag go /des 'chad do// sna khrag la rta'i sog pa bsregs pa'i thal ba sna ru bus kyang 'chad do// dus su ma chod par gyur na/ lces dpung pa la sleb pa'i mar rtsa bsreg go /so la srin bu byung na/ rna chung ba bsregs na phan no// 'bu gzer la srin bu dmar leb dang*/ shing kun dang*/ gla rtsi gsum chang phul gang la btab nas btang na zhi bar 'gyur ro// lce chung babs pa la/ g.yer ma/ pho ba ris btags la khye'u sus steng du mar bskus la de'i steng du blugs la brdeg spyi bor mar bsku/ ras bal bkab la slu gu'i nang du me bcug la bsreg go /spyi bo nas skra tshum gcig bcings/ 'phang lo nas bton la gcud do// mchu bad kan gyis na ba la/ a ru ra/ bu ram gnyis zhib par btags la/ khye'us 'thung ba'i nu zho la sbyar la bsku/ dar dmar pos bkab la zhag gsum bzhag de nas bshu/ des 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// mchu ral na dar skud kyis btsems/ bcad 'byor dom mkhris rma khar gdab/ steng du gar sbyin gyis bsdams/

mchu mi bsgul/ mi bgad do// so sra bar bya ba la sbang ma/ seng phram/ ru rta/ pi pi ling*/ 'bras bu gsum btsod rnams cha bsnyams la sbrang rtsi la sbyar te/ lto stong la so'i phyi dang rnyil thog tu byugs na sra zhing brtan pa 'gyur ro// khong par khab song na/ ri bong gi spu'am/ bya rgod kyi 'dom spu gang rung dang*/ bag phye sla nga ru ser tsam brngos pa dang*/ 'o ma bsres pa'i thug pa/ nang ma gsum tsam gtang*/ a ru ra dang*/ tsha la bsres la bag re gtang*/ zas gzhan mi gtang*/ skom bskyungs/ gan rkyal du nyal la 'gyur du mi gzhug go /des phan no// mid par rus pa'am/ gra ma'am/ nya rus zug na ras bal lam/ srin bal lam/ dar gsing la/ ras kyi skud pa btags la mid pa 'das tsam du mid/ ske'i rtsa bar khu tshur gyis tug tug byas te/ ske phar log tshur log lnga tsam du bya/ des sngar gyi skud pa nas dal bus 'then pas 'byung nges so// mi chus khyer ba zin na kha sbub tu byas la/ steng nas mis mnan la kha sna nas chu dbyung*/ yang na phyugs la bkal la mgo 'phyang du bcug pas sos so// mi 'gags na/ thag pa mi gcad par bkrol la kha sna nas thal mos bkab la/ dbugs dal gyis gtang ngo*// kha zas kyis brnangs pa la/ ltag par khu tshur gsum drag tu brdeg go /sog dbrag tu gnyis brdeg go /rlig pa skrangs na/ rmong gseb kyi rtsa la me btsa' bya/ rgyab kyi mkhal gsang bsreg go /pags pa rlon pas lums su gzhug go /mkhan pa'i lo ma rlon pa sla ngar rngos/ ras kyis phur la dugs bya/ mig kha bas phyid ba la/ rang gi dri chus byugs na phan no// rkang pa'i ser ga ma sos na sbyin bzang pos byugs nas/ krad dum gcig glan na sos so// 'khru ba bcad pa la/ tsha 'khru la/ rtsa tsha la myur du 'khru/ lus stobs che la dang ga mi bde/ 'khrus pa de chu ru bcug pas mi 'jig par 'dril na/ tsha 'khru yin pas tho rangs kyi skar chu thub tshad 'thungs na 'chad do// grang 'khru ni lus stobs chung ba dang*/

dang ga bde/ 'khrus pa chu ru bcug na 'jig de la bcud gtang ngo*// chu 'gags pa la spu ltag tu gru bu bcug nas snam bus rgyab 'ching byas pas 'byung ngo*// yang na sdig pa ka ka ru dang*/ srin bu ka ka ru dang*/ gla rtsi dang*/ sug smel/ sbur mgyogs kyi nang shun/ lcam pa rnams chang zhim po dang sbyar la gtang ngo*// gru mo bud na/ dpung pa nas gcig gis yar 'then/ gcig gis lag ngar nas mar 'then la/ sman pas lag mthil gyis mi drag par nang du phul bas tshud do// de nas phyin pas bsdams la mgul du gdags/ me btsa' bya'o// dpung pa bud na thag pa ring pos mkhrig ma nas btags la/ sman pas nad pa'i mchan 'og tu gru bu bcug la yar 'then/ gzhan gyis thag pa'i sna nas mar thad kar 'then la/ thag pa'i dkyil du ber kas brdeg des the tshom med par tshud do// mkhrig ma'i tshigs bud na/ mthongs ka mnyam po ru phying pa bting la/ steng du lag pa kha phub tu bzhag rkang pas mnan/ sor mo rnams nas kyang 'then/ tshud nas lag 'gag la me btsa' bya'o// brla dang rje ngar chag pa kun ching 'dra bar bya ste/ phying pa dang*/ byang bu'i ring thung lhu tshigs dang mnyam/ byang bu dang phying pa sog kar byas la sbom pa lhu tshigs phyogs su gtang*/ sha dang phying ba'i phyogs su rta'i ze rngog dang*/ rtsid pa gtang*/ spyir lhu gcig chag pa la/ lhu gnyis bcing ngo*// 'jar dang srad bu dam lhod ran par bya/ rma yod na thad dkar 'dzag sgo gtod do// rkang lag chag pa 'og tu mi gzhug rkang pa bsnyams la gan rkyal tu nyal lo// dpyi chag pa la sa skyong mor brkos la rtsa mthug po bting la/ ma chag pa 'og tu bcug la/ chag pa la bong spu dang sbyin bzang pos hel gyis glan la 'phongs su 'dzag khung byas la 'gul du mi gzhug rkang pa mnyam la gan rkyal du nyal lo// zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig na 'byor ba 'dra na me btsa' bya/ khong pa na ba dang*/ lus po za ba/ 'brum pa mang po 'ong ba/

khyad par du grang na za ba'i chu ser la/ nye'u phul gang la tsha ba gsum mang du btab ste/ bu ram rdog po gcig btab la/ ma 'dreg par dkrugs shing bskol/ drod ma yal ba la phyed btang la steng nas gos kyis byibs la rdul gdon/ yang phyed 'phro btang la bya'o// chu ser gyi phyi bshal zab bo// srin nad la bong nga nag po sran ma tsam gcig dang*/ 'bri mog gi rtsi bzhur ba la btab ste btags la/ mar dkar la ril bu mtheb tshigs tsam gsum byas la de nas gsang chab legs po byas la me la bsros te dros pa dang*/ sman gyi reng bu mas yar gtang ngo*// des nges par sel lo// phyugs cis spos kyang rnga snying bsregs pas zhi bar 'gyur ro// phyugs kyi khong du khab rgyud song ngam/ sems can song na/ tsha dang mar bsres nas kha ru bcug pas/ phyag phyag zer na/ da lta rang sos par 'gyur ro// rma'i khrag ma chod na rta sbangs dron mo'i khu ba btsir na/ ji lta bu yang chod par 'gyur ro// ja la bsres nas btang na yang chog go /rna bar sems can song na mkhan pa'i lo ma brdungs pa'i khu ba blugs na 'byung ngo*// yang na btsong gi khu ba'am/ skyes pa'i sa bon blugs pas 'byung ngo*// rna bar sran ma'am 'bru song na/ skud pa klod klod la sbyin bzang po bskus la/ sran ma la sbyar/ grangs pa dang 'then pas 'byung nges so// rna bar lug shig song na/ chang bzang po nyal khar blugs pas 'byung ngo*// ra shig pa song na/ g.yer chu blugs pas 'chi'o// rna ba nas rnag yun ring por 'dzag na shing kun tsha chu la btsos ma thigs pa gsum blugs pas chad do// rna ba krog krog zer zhing*/ chu ser 'bab pa la/ dan da dang*/ thar nu sbyar la gtang*/ rna ba 'on pa la shu dag dang bya brun/ wa sha bsres pa'i sha rnams cha bsnyams te/ mar nag gi nang du gdus nas rna bar blugs na thos par 'gyur ro// rna ba dbye ru btub mi btub brtag pa ni/ rna ba'i nang ljan ljin gyis gang nas mdog snum na btub/

song nge byas nas skya na mi btub bo// de la dang po sbyang ba ni/ la phug gam/ sgog skya gang rung gi khu ba dang*/ mar nag la/ sga/ rgyam tsha/ tsha/ yung ba btab la/ rna bar blugs pa la bal gtsang mas dgag zhag gsum de ltar byas/ de nas lug mgo rnying pa'am/ nyungs ma brdungs pa btsos pa'i rlangs pas bdug de nas dbyi mo'i lo ma dang*/ shin kun/ la phug skam po// sgog skya'i khu ba sbyar la gtang*/ sbang ma'i zan dron glan la dkri/ de nas nyi ma phyed tsam gcig nas/ btub tshad 'bru/ rngab rus drang*/ yang sngar ltar bya/ de lta bu lan gsum byas na phyed nges so/ rna ba'i bshal la/ rgya tsha/ gser gyi phud bu/ shu dag sgog skya bzhi cha bsnyams la/ ru rta bag tsam gcig de rnams zhib par btags la bal gtsang ma'i khud du gril la/ sgog chur bcug cing*/ rna bar thigs pa gsum btig go /zhag gnyis su nyin re la lan gsum gsum btig go /de nas lcags kyi sbu gu rna bar bcug la bzhibs/ bag tsam dka' na'ang sman gtang*/ des rna ba'i nad thams cad med par 'gyur ro// yang rna ba 'on pa la/ gla rtsi/ kha ru tsha/ shing tsha/ shing kun/ rma bya'i mdongs/ la phug ru rta/ ug chos kyi rtsa ba rnams mar khu rnying pa'am/ mar rnying pa la sbyar la/ thigs pa gsum blugs la bkru'o// wa ba bcos pa la ol gong bcu gsum/ nya sha mthe bong tsam gcig shing tsha sor bzhi/ wa tsha/ sga/ bzang drug ka ra bam gcig 'di brtag su srang gcig ru rta cho lo tsam gcig ut+pal sngon po rnams kyi phye ma/ sga sbar mo gsum gdus pa'i khu ba drod ma yal ba chang phul gang btab la/ gos kyis byibs la bzhag skya sbos byung ba dang tho rang khyem bu gsum gsum gtang ngo*// de nas shigs pa'o// ol gong lo lon pa bdun/ rgya tsha sran ma tsam gcig ba sha ka ril ma tsam gcig wa tsha mthe bong tsam gcig tig ta sor lnga tsam gcig ka ra brdar gcig spang rgyan dkar po rtsa ba dang bcas pa bdun/ de rnams zhib par btags la/ tho rangs khyem bu do do btang*/

des rjes gcod do// chu rtsa sor drug sga skya rdog po lnga/ dzā ti sran ma tsam gcig wa tsha mthe bong tsam gcig sug smel thun gcig sman sga rdog po gcig de rnams zhib par byas la/ sbrang dang*/ bu ram gyis ril bu byas la nang re la re re gtang*/ des phyis mi ldang bar byed do// chu 'gags pa la/ a ru ra dang*/ rgya tsha/ rgya skyegs/ nyi dga'i 'bras bu dang sbyar la gtang ngo*// nyi dga' gcig pus kyang sel lo// rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar la/ ka sho kan dha/ gze ma/ ra mo shag nye shing ba/ lca ba rnams lan gsum gdus pa'i khu ba dang mar sbyar/ de gdus pa de chu chor ba dang*/ mar nyi tshe lus pa ngang phog la 'bras bu gsum dang*/ ru rta/ rgyam tsha/ sug smel/ bu ram dang*/ sbrang rnams legs par sbyar la ras su dkrug go /des ni mkhal nad chu ser dang*/ rus nad la sogs zhi bar byed do// de bal la sogs pa la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya'o// glo ba'i nad la bse ru cha gcig sha ba'i gwa dor de tsam gcig rgya ru bse ru tsam bzhi/ a krong bse ru tsam brgyad/ de rnams zhib par btags la/ ka ra de'i bungs mnyam par sbyar la gtang ngo*// ru rta cha gcig a ru ra de'i nyis 'gyur/ chu dro ba la sbyar la btang na rked pa na ba'i zug gzer 'joms so// bu ram dang 'o skol dron mo btang bas phan no// ru rta dang*/ shu dag zhib par btags nas bud med nu zho la sbyar te mig tu blugs na nad thams cad sel lo// sgog skya me mdag skam po'i nang du bsros nas/ de btsir ba'i khu ba rna ba gang bar blugs na rna ba 'on pa sos so/ mig dmar la tshags pa la/ 'bras bu gsum cha bsnyams te bud med kyi nu zho la sbyar nas bskus na sos so// dri chu 'gags pa la/ rgyam tsha/ sdig pa ka ka ru/ srin bu ka ka ru/ rgyam tsho gser gyi bye ma/ tsha bul med pa/ dud pa rnams cha bsnyams nas gtang na 'byung ngo*// glang thabs bcos pa la bzhi ste/ 'bu glang ni ha cang mi sbo/

rgyu ma tsha rab rab 'ong*/ de la gla rtsi dang*/ sgog skya rnams sbyar la gtang ngo*// tsha glang ni ha cang mi sbo// nyi ma tshan de'am/ zas bcud can gyis ldang*/ de la long rtsa gnyis gtar la bsil sman gtang ngo*// grang glang ni grang ba la rkyen nas ldang*/ de la ro smad la dugs dang bsku byug bya/ pi pi ling*/ bca' sga/ a ru ra rnams chang ngam chu la sbyar la gtang*/ sna bcags/ des ma phan na/ lte ba bsreg go /rlung glang ni/ rlung gyen du log pas gsus pa ther gyis sbos te/ de la dugs dang bsku byug bya/ reng bu bya/ des ma phan na gsus par an tshugs su bsreg go /bad rlung gis mig 'grib na/ ltag pa'i bdud khung g.yas g.yon du spu 'khyil pa'i gnad yod de/ der mnan na mig na ba'am/ bem por tshor ba 'ong*/ der thur ma sor gsum 'phangs na mig 'gul bas thur ma 'gul lo// rma khar spra ba gsum bzhag go /yang rting pa'i chu ba'i dkyil du thig gdab// 'phred la dreg mtshams su thig gdab pa'i bya rog rjes la thur ma theb sor gang brdeg mig 'gul na thur ma 'gul lo// rjes la spra ba gsum bzhag des rab rib sel lo// tshad rnying rus pa la zhen pa la/ rgya sne bzhi sbyor zhes bya ste/ rgya sne'u dang*/ rgya tsha dang*/ a ru ra dang*/ tsha ba che na/ skyu ru ra yang gtang*/ mkhris pa che na bzal mo'i chu/ grang ba che na tshang la sbyar ro// de nas sman btang la 'og tu thal ba bting la steng nas mal cha mang pos gtibs nas rdul dbyung*/ de nas phyes dbyi'o// lan gsum gyis rus pa'i nad thon par 'gyur ro// khyis rmugs pa la/ bzung ma thag tu/ chu ngan gyis bkrus la/ ra spu dang khyi spus mnan la/ ra skud dang*/ khyi skud kyis bcing*/ spyod lam gang yang bsrung mi dgos so// shu ba la/ ti tsha/ mu zi nag po ka ra'i skogs pa bsregs la/ sgog skya drung ba gcig dud pa/ ra lug gi sog pa'i thal ba/ ra spu/ khyi spu'i gzhob/ bya rlog rlog pa'i 'bras bu/

'brang gi skrad rnying gi gzhob/ ri bong gi ril ma bdun/ de rnams zhib par btags la/ mi'i zhun nam/ tshil bu la sbyar la bsku/ nyi ma la gdung ngo*// shu ba ji lta bu yang sos so// mes tshig pa la/ ra dang bong bu'i mcher ba'i khrag skrad snying pa'i gzhob/ stag sha ba/ mkhris pa rnyed tshad/ rdo pha bong long bu/ chu ba'i thal ba/ ka ra'i skogs pa'i thal ba/ rgya snag dud pa/ bul tog nya lcibs skam po/ khye'us 'thung ba'i nu zho la sbyar nas bsku'o// ji lta bu yang 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// nad bcos thabs mdzub tshugs su bstan pa'i man ngag yang dag pa 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra/ gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ 'thor dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so// //sman la thun tshad gong nas bshad pa bzhin bya/ thun tshad ma bshad pa rnams ni mthun sbyor zhes bya ba yin pas/ che chung mi lta'o// sa ma ya/ na ra skan/ sa māp+ta mi thi// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// dug gso byed bdud rtsi 'phel byed ces bya ba 'di la/ dang po yin min brtag pa ni/ mig sprin ser la nag po'i thig le 'ong*/ de nad gzhan la 'ong bas/ rked pa man chad chu ru bcug pas/ dar gcig nas phyung la me la bsros pas thams cad nag por song na yin/ so'i rtsa ba dang*/ sen mo mdog mi gcig pa dang*/ rnyil dang so sor 'bye ba 'ong*/ de la nya'i sha bsregs nas zos pas brtsen yin/ sen mo'i mdog ma grugs/ sen mo dmar po la nag po'am/ sngon po'am/ ser po'i spu ris 'byung*/ de la lus po thams cad la ra khrag byugs pas/ sen mo thams cad mdog nag por gyur na yin/ sha mdog nyams nas sngar bas sngo la rlog bu can du 'ong*/ de la lus po la lug gi slos byugs la/ pags rlon gyis dkris pas nag po'am/ sngon po'am/ ser po'i ri mo byung na yin/ lce'i logs sam steng du mdog mi gcig pa'i thig le'am/

spu shad lta bu 'byung*/ de la rtsa gnyis gtar la khrag dang chu rtsa gnyis chang la btab ste/ de bskol nas lce thams cad sngon por song na yin/ chu gtsang gi nang du na ba dang*/ mi na ba'i mchil ma btab pas/ na ba'i gting du 'gro'o// mi na ba'i kha ru 'ong*/ nad pa'i dri chu dron mo la na ba dang*/ mi na ba'i skra dus gcig bcug pas/ na ba'i skra tshig nas phos phos 'chad/ kyag kyog du 'gro/ mi na ba'i sngar bzhin 'ong ngo*// mkhar sgong bsregs pa la/ na ba dang*/ mi na ba'i mchil ma bskyur bas/ na ba'i mchil ma'i thal ba nag por 'ong*/ mi na ba'i dkar por 'ong*/ ldum bu re ral tshum gcig zhib par btags la 'o ma la btab la/ khong du btang bas nad tshabs che na skyug go /chung na skyugs log mi na ba la btang na ci yang mi 'ong*/ khong na dug yod na dri chu dud kha mtha' skya 'ong*/ snying mi dga'/ tshig pa za/ sngar mi 'ong bar rngul skabs su yong*/ rkang lag sa la btsugs na brtse/ gam mig mi mthong*/ rgyang mig gsal/ lces zas kyi ro mi tshor/ mchu sbrid/ gre ba tsha/ tshigs gzhi sbrid cing khol/ gsar rnying gang yin kyang dang ga 'gags/ sgyid bskyur/ cha yis nyams lci/ gnyid che/ sems la me dang nyi ma 'dod de 'dug na me dang nyi ma la mi tshugs par grib ma 'dod de/ grib ma la ya mi tshugs/ yul sdug pa mthong yang mtshan ma mi ldang*/ ro tsa ba med/ gsar rnying gang yin kyang*/ skabs su mig mi gsal/ mchin pa dug gi zhang po yin pas gtso bor na ba 'ong*/ de la babs na bcos pa yang dka'/ byung ma thag mgo dang pho ba na/ 'khru skyug gang yin gcig byed nyen yod/ sngar nas yod pa'i nad gzhi gang rung dang bsdongs/ phyi rtags su dug gsar pa yin na/ dbugs shin tu mi bde/ dug rnying pa yin na glo chung 'ong*/ kha mchil mar skyur snying 'dod/ khyad par gyi rtags 'di yin te/ 'brum pa dmar po lus la gtams byung nas res zhi/ res 'ong byed na smin pa'i rtags yin pas/

gso ru mi rung*/ de la sman mi gtang ngo*// gzhan gong gi rtags rnams dang*/ thor bu bag tsam bad kan la sogs nad gzhan la yang 'byung ba yod pas/ rtags 'di rnams phar cher byung na dug yin no// yin nges pa'i rtags ni/ dngul ra med pa la bug pa phug ste/ skud pa btags la khar bzhag nub gcig bzhag pas shin tu nag cing*/ snag tsha bzang po bzhin du 'gyur te/ de drag tu phyis na med par 'gyur ro// phyi ba dka' na 'tsho ba dka' ba yin/ yang khyad par gyi rtags ni/ rma bya'i mdongs mar la gtums te/ mid pas dug yin kyang yin la bcos kyang mi btub na rul nas 'gro'o// de la mi 'jug go /tshabs che na ri mo yal nas 'gro/ de la sman dang stobs 'dren/ tshabs chung na g.ya' yal tsam 'byung*/ bcos dka'/ gzhung dang mthun no// khong na dug med na khong na tshad pa la sogs ji ltar yod kyang ri mo sa le'ang*/ de la bcos ka yang mi dgos so// yang nad pa rang gi dri chu bar pa la mur gong gi skra phyi la gzhug dug yin na rgyus pa thab tu bcug pa bzhin 'gro'o// mi 'tsho'i rtags ni/ dbugs thung la phrag pa gnyis la 'brum pa nag po 'byung ba dang*/ lus la 'brum pa dmar po byung nas/ de nas nag por 'gyur ba dang*/ sor mo rnams la tsher ma zug pa snyam byed pa'i 'brum pa 'byung*/ dri chen dang dri chu yang nas yang du sdom par byed pa rnams ni gso ru mi rung ngo*// yang kha cig la rtags de dag med kyang*/ sha rus mig tu song ste/ lus zungs zad na gso ru mi rung ba yin no// rtags gong ma rnams gang byung yang gso bar bya ste/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag gdon bcos la sogs bya'o// de la dug lus gang la khyab kyang pho bar bsdu ba'i man ngag la/ snga dro'i lto bsrung*/ phyi dro'i zas la nan tan bskyed/ lto stong la a ru ra'i thang zhag bdun la sogs par gtang*/ de nas sum yar du gtang*/ spyod lam ni/ me dang nyi ma bud med/

ngal dub/ smra ba mang po rnams bsrung*/ sman gtang ba'i dus su bud med kyis mthong du yang mi rung*/ zas dkar gsum mtha' dag spang*/ nya sha dang*/ ri bong gi sha dang*/ bshul chags kyi sha rnams spang*/ pho ba na hril hril byung na a ru ra'i thang ma zhu ba yin pas 'phro bcad/ chang gsar pa dang*/ sha gsar pa nyams dang sbyar la bsten/ de yang chang mang na mi dga'o// de ni sman gyis gzhi bzung zhing*/ nad bsdu ba'i man ngag yang dag ba'o// dngos gzhi'i sman ni/ zangs ma bzang po sgong shun tsam du glebs pa/ mu zi dri chus lde gu byas la de la byug lugs phor du blugs la/ kha lci bas legs par bcad do// sbud pa'i sol mes legs par bzhu bde legs par btags te/ de nas chu bre gang la/ a ru ra bcu gcig legs par sbangs te/ de me mi che bas bskol/ ba chu cung zad bskams tsa na/ ba chu rim gyis bsnan/ a ru ra'i rdog po rim gyis bton te/ khab kyis gtsags pas khu ba rnams ci myur gyis thon nas 'ong*/ de'i khu ba khyor re la zangs thal gser zho re'i bongs tsam re lto stong la gtang*/ de nas ka ra dum re mur ro// des dug dmu chu song ba la ni dmu chu'i 'phrul chags su 'gyur ro// lto stong la btang bas zhag bdun gyis nges par dug nad sel lo// rjes la bcud gal che'o// mi de'i dang po nas nad gzhi'i bye brag shes par bya ste/ bad kan dang khrag shas che na/ bzal chags kyi chu la sbyar/ rlung shas che na chang la sbyar/ mkhris pa shas che na ba nag mo'i chu la sbyar/ gang yang ngos ma zin na/ bsres la gtang ngo*// khyad par mchog tu gyur pa'i sbyor ba'o// de nas lus yang ba dang ngag bde bar 'gyur ro// lus kyi rngul 'chad/ bya ba gang yang rang gis nus pa snyam byed na sman zug pa yin pas rngul gdon par bya'o// sman bungs ci tsam sbyor ba'i rgya sne'u dang*/ ka sho kan dha dang cha bsnyams/ dud pa rgya sne'u'i sum cha tsam btang*/

de dang mnyam pa'i gu gul nag po/ de rnams ba chu la zhib par sbyar la/ ril bu sran ma che shos tsam bya/ de nas mi de dang po nas/ nad gzhi khrag dang mkhris pa shas che ba na/ ba zal chags kyi chu khyor ba gang la ril bu bdun nam bcu gcig srod la sbyar la nub mo mal dron mor byibs la bzhag tho rangs khong du btang la mal bde bar nyal/ thog nas mal cha dro la yang bas byibs pas rngul mang du dbyung*/ zug gzer byung na sos pa yin pas/ gangs chu zug tshad btung*/ des zhi bar 'gyur/ rngul 'thon pa dang*/ phye 'thor la dril bar bya'o// de'i nyin par rang nas bde zhing yang bar tshor bar 'gyur ro// bad rlung shas che na chang gi rta la gtang*/ gong dang 'dra/ de nas nang gcig mi btang bar ngal gso/ yang gtang ngo*// de lta bu lan bdun nam bcu gcig gis ci ltar na yang cha phyed cing sos bar 'gyur ro// rjes ni bcud kyis gsos te/ chang 'jam po ran pa dang*/ sha gsar pa 'ju mi 'ju brtags la gtang ngo*// dus thams cad la gtar ga dang*/ me btsa' dang drag shul gyi las spong*/ mthar nad de rnams dag par ma gyur na/ dug ro 'don pa bdud rtsi'i bcud/ brag zhun gyi sbyor ba ni/ brag zhun legs par btul la/ dang po ril ma tsam re lto stong la btang*/ btung ba cong zhi'i chus bya'o// de lta bu zla ba phyed tshun chad kyis dug las gyur pa'i nad ma lus pa sel bar 'gyur ro// de bsten par bya ba'i yan lag nad sos nas/ lo dus tshun chad/ ri bong la sogs bshul chags kyi sha thams cad spang*/ me tshan dang nyi tshan spang*/ khyad par du rta zhon pa spang*/ lus po dro bar byas pas dus nges pa med par bcag go /khyad par mchog tu gyur pa'i man ngag go /gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ dug gso ba'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi 'phel byed ces bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so// sa māp+ta mi thi// //oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// shin tu drag po mi bzad pa'i sha dug gso ba'i gdams ngag ha la 'joms byed ces bya ba 'di la/

dang po rtags brtag pa ni/ 'di ni 'phral la gsod par byed pa'i nad yin te/ gre ba nas zas dang*/ sman dang chu mi thar/ bag re thar yang 'phral la skyug skyugs pas bde ba snyam byed kyang slar la thu ba yin te/ skad cig re re la 'gyur zhing thu ru 'gro ba'i nad yin/ shes pa gsal la snying mi dga'/ zos ma 'phral la ldang ba yang yod/ nyin mtshan phyed dam/ nyin zhag gcig gam/ zhag gcig las mi thogs par ldang ste/ mig mi phyed par rdzi ma phab nas sleng nge btsun me byas nas mig srib par 'ong*/ gre ba mi bde bar 'gags/ lce chung babs pa snyam byed/ thum thum mid na bde ba snyam byed/ skad cig la gre ba 'dzer/ lce ser la skam/ mig mi gsal/ mi bzod par pho bar zug nas sbo/ rims kyis 'debs pa'i snga rtags bzhin du mgo bo na/ rus pa khol/ grang shum byed/ shes pa snyom mo// sha dug mi bzad pa tshabs chen po 'ong na dri chu yang bsdam/ rtsa yang khrag nad dang*/ rims drag po ltar sbo zhing grims la drag tu 'bar/ drag po mi bzad pa'i dug ces bya ste/ gso long med par kun gzhi 'phos pas myur du bsgrims la gso/ de yang thog mar bde zhing zug gzer mi 'ong ste snga rtags phra mo shar ba dang myur bar 'bod/ de la sman sbyar ba ni/ thog mar ser ga ba mo ma byung ba'i dus su/ 'om bu'i lo ma zil pa can gtubs la gri bskam byas te/ de khram khrum du brdungs la srang re tsam bskol ba'i thang gtang ngo*// de gcig pus kyang 'tsho'o// sman de rnying na nus pa chung ngo*// spang rgyan dkar po'i rtsa ba'am/ me tog gang rung ka ra dang sbyar la gtang*/ ldum bu re ral dang*/ chig thub dkar po dang*/ skyes pa'i bar shun/ sro lo dkar po/ 'om bu/ so pha gsar pa yag ma rnams so so rang rang re'i chig thang gtang ngo*// thab 'og gi sa tshig pa'i khu ba bgrungs la gtang ngo*// yang srin gyis gre ba 'gags pa yin pas/ srin bzlog pa'i thabs la/

dang po sha gang las byung brtags la/ sha gang las byung ba'i brun phul gang ngam/ bre phyed tsam spangs la/ de ras tshags la btsags te kha nas gtang ngo*// yar mar mthar na/ ser kha nas ni ru ha ltar gtang*/ chur khu'am/ zho gsad pa'am 'o ma gsad pa dang bsres la gtang*/ bu ram dum gcig btab na yang srin bu tshang du 'jug par 'gyur ro// srin phyis mi ldang bar bya ba la/ chu bzang po bre gang bskol la phul gang du gdu'o// 'dus pa dang shing kun ril ma tsam gcig btab la zhu ba dang gtang ngo*// byang g.yag gi sha las byung na yul g.yag gi brun la bya/ sha ba la ba lang*/ gna' ba la lug dgo ba la ra/ rkyang gi sha las byung na rta'i brun la bya'o// yang lugs gcig la/ rdza longs ma spyad pa'i rdza'am/ so phag khram khrum du brdungs la chu bre gang du blugs la bre phyed du gdu/ de la yung ba dang a ru ra dang bong nga dkar po/ 'om bu rnams brdungs la chu bre phyed po bzhi phul gang du gdus la khong du gtang ngo*// bdud rtsi 'dis ma sos pa gang yang med do// yang srin gyis gre ba 'gags pa la chu rdo grang mo dang*/ brod pa chus bkang bas pho ba dang brang la bdugs pas kyang srin ldog par 'gyur ro// byi tang ga srin sman ma ru rtse/ phur mo'i lo ma/ gu gul dkar po/ stag sha ba/ ga pur rnams chu la sbyangs la gtang*/ des kyang srin ldog go /srin bu sha'i dug gis bred nas/ snod nas gre ba'i nang du bros pas/ srin bu dang dug gi rlangs pas gre ba'i sbugs 'gags par byed pas/ srin bzlog pa kho na gces so// srin bu bsdu ba ni sbrang rtsi g.yung dang*/ ka ra chu gtsang sbyar la thog mar gtang*/ de nas gong gi sman gtang yang legs/ yang na gla rtsi'i chu gtang ngo*// rke dang pho ba nam tshang la// 'khrul 'khor chu yi gzer ma bya// rgya mtsho lcid med dugs kyis bdug /grang dug mtha' dag bya ba dang*// steng rlung bsdoms kyang phan pa yin// des na srin bu ldog par 'gyur// zhes pas skyugs dang*/

gtar ga me btsa' mi bya/ lto bshal 'dzugs pa dka' ba yin te ma zug na skyugs pa gtang yang thub bo// ni ru ha dang reng bu bsngags so// zas dang spyod lam ni dkar gsum/ skyur gsum/ sha rul sum drod kyi zas thams cad spangs te/ nad 'di me'i rang bzhin yin pas so// nad 'di snum pas snum can gyi zas thams cad spang*/ lci snum drod kyi rang bzhin sa chu me las byung ba bad kan dang mkhris pa 'dres pa'i nad yin pas/ nyungs ma'i thug pa bag re yang gtang ngo*// bsil sman mtha' dag bsten/ char chu dang g.ya' chu dang gangs chu dang sa rting khron pa bsil ba'i chu rnams tshur dang*/ mu zi ba tsha med pa rnams sman sbyar ba dang*/ sman dbul ba dang*/ skom du gtang ngo*// drus thug 'bras thug lcags khu gtang ngo*// mjug tu dur byid kyis gtso byas pa'i bshal gcig gtang ngo*// yang na a ru ra nyi shu rtsa gcig btsos la khu ba yang yang gtang ngo*// phyis des nad 'khren dang nad ro mi 'byung ngo*// de nas sha dug dang btsan dug thun mong du bcos pa'i sman sbyar ni/ bya rgod spos kyi me tog dang nyungs gzhi'i me tog dang bong nga dkar po/ a ru ra rnams cha mnyam/ de rnams kyi nyis 'gyur ldum bu re ral gtang*/ de rnams zhib par btags la gangs chus phul la gtang ngo*/ yang na tsha bzang po bul med pa dang ka ra dkar po mnyam par chu la lhur byas la gtang ngo*// yang mi'i dri chen skam po dang tsha la cha mnyam nas chu la sbyar nas btang na so 'thoms par gyur pa la yang slebs pas chog pa yin no// yang na shu dag mthe bong tsam gcig chu la sbyangs nas gtang yang phan no// sha dug gis gre ba 'thams pa la/ nad pa rang gi gong rtsa g.yas pa'i dri ma sla ngar dar cig bsdus pas btang bas shin tu phan no// a ru ra/ brag zhun/ bong nga dkar po gsum cha mnyam nas zhib par byas la chu la sbyar nas btang na sha dug nges par sel lo// yang na bong bu ga dmar phub kyi khud du bkyigs la/
