snying zho sha'i thang btang ngo*// gsher byer la phur mo'i lo ma'i thal ba/ ba bla/ ldong ros/ myang rtsi spras kyis lha ba skems/ sha gsar tsho khu gtang ngo*// klad pa gso ba'i thabs la/ rus pa'i gam gtib pas rus 'dzer gyis spri btsan nas bar du rnag zhugs pa yod/ rus 'dzer phyung ba'i rjes la spri sngon po 'byung ba yang yod de/ de la ga pur/ gur gum/ 'dam bu sbyar la gdab/ spri dang klad pa'i bar gyi rnag brtol/ de nas nag po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ mang pos 'khrugs na sha'u dmar po sreg ge 'dug na nyen med/ spri ral na dar ya kan dang bcas 'byor/ dom mkhris/ 'om bu'i bar shun gyi 'dam rnams gtang*/ klad pa 'dzag na mu tig dang dom mkhris/ khye'us 'thungs pa'i nu zho dang sbyar la/ 'thems su stag sha bskus la gtang*/ des chad do// klad pa tsho sbos ni/ rtse chung dang phyi yul tsha/ zug gzer che la dang ga mi bde/ rma che la rnag mang*/ de la nya ra 'bad/ rus pa nyams bskyung ngo*// grang sbos ni phyi yul la sogs pa grang ba'o// de ni grang rlung skyes pa las 'byung ngo*// sha'u rmen pa'i thabs su prog prog pos skyes na mnan pas kyang ma non na 'khar ba'i thur mas bsreg rtse mo skya khyi le byas nas/ chu 'jigs pa 'ong ste/ mnan pas ma non na ra gan nam/ lcang mas bsreg bsregs pas de rnams nyol nyol por 'gro ste/ 'og nas sha'u gsha' ma skye'o// dpyad bcos bya ru mi rung*/ klad pa gtib na glum gyi nye'u gtang*/ sha gsar chang gsar gtang*/ rtsa chod pa la gang du me btsa' gdab/ khrag ma chod na spra bas bsregs pas chod/ spyi gtsug nas mtshog ma'i ngos su mtshon gang bcal ba na rtsa gcig yod de/ de chod na spyi gtsug nas mtshog ma'i bar thams cad tsha lam lam 'ong bas/ de la spyi gtsug tu spra ba gsum bzhag spru ba'i rtsa ba'am/ gro ga'i rtsa ba'am/ za 'og gi gzhob kyi thal bas bcad/ phyi 'thems kyis mnan/ rtsa'i gong 'og tu me btsa' gdab/

rna ba'i mdun rgyab kyi rtsa sgor snad na rtse chung gdab/ zhu mkhan dang 'om bu'i dugs kyis rtsa'i tsha ba 'don/ rma'i tho phyi gzer zhing rtsa 'phar na gtar ga byas pas phan no// yang na bsregs na phan no// lha ba'i rtsa'i 'od dang*/ ser kha'i 'od nor nyen yod de/ lha rtsa'i 'od ni smug ser kha'i 'od ni gnag par 'ong*/ rtsa chod na gser gyis bsros la dom mkhris rtsa khar gdab/ gzer rtsa chod nas khrag chu mig lta bur byung na zhag gnyis sam gsum na lha ba sngo sob sob tu song nas 'chi'o// rgya rtsa zhes bya ba mtshog ma nas ltag khung thug pa rtsa sbom po cig yod/ rna ba'i mdun rgyab gnyis na dpag bsam gyi ljon shing bzhi yod/ spyi bo nas yar lag pa'i sor mo bkram pa bzhin yod/ dpral ba'i zur gnyis na yar rtsa 'greng bu gnyis yod de/ de chad na bcos thabs med de 'chi/ btsan pa sman gyis gso'o// rma thog tu rdo phog pa dang*/ mthongs ka mkhrang pa'am/ re bzhi'am/ ka gdung la brdabs nas klad pa'i mtsho 'khrugs te gdong ba lci la mig ri bong rdzis non pa 'dra la/ skyugs shing col 'khrul mang na rtse'u chung g.yas g.yon gtang*/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu gsang dbye/ skra bregs la spod sna tshogs dang*/ spang spos dang mar dang sbyar la mgo khyab par byugs/ gra phying la 'bo la log bzhin byas la/ khram shar byas te skyur la phab la glan/ zhag bdun dar dang men tris rgya chings bya/ de'i steng du blang 'breng dang sog mig gis rgya chings bya/ sgo bzhir phur bus bsnol la brdegs/ zhag bdun mi bkrol par bzhag rgya srubs su mar dang tshil bu bzhu bas zhun bya/ gla sgang gi phye ma gdab/ spos kyi phye ma dang mar dang tshil bu sbyar la byugs/ re bal gyi 'dab ma khye'u nu zho 'thungs pa'i chus drod phab la/ de'i steng du phying bu drod phab la dgab/ de nas pags bu drod phab la dgab/ de nas 'jag gis dkri/ sha 'thems dang rus 'thems dang lung 'bur rnams zla ba gcig gis sangs ba srid/

na tsha chung na thub pa yin/ zug gzer che na gas sna dang rtsa'i yar sna mar snar me btsa' bya/ gtsag kha bstan du mi rung*/ pags pa ma ral ba la yon tan gsum yod de/ sha'i dbugs mi 'chor ba'i yon tan dang*/ khrag ma shor bas rus pa la khrag mi 'chor ba'i yon tan dang*/ rus pa dang pags pa'i dbugs ma shor bas sha dang khrag 'tsho/ khrag gis rus pa 'tsho/ drod kyis bcos pas khrag dang chu ser skam ste rang skam du gar song cha med par 'gro'o// zhag gsum bzhi na kha zas yen la gtad/ de nas sha chang sprugs ma gtang*/ tsha ba che na bsil drod khye'ur gtang*/ lto tshas na rnag tu 'gro nyen che/ mer mer bor 'ong ste brtol du mi rung ngo*// byas pa'i mgo chag pa bcos pa ni/ byis pa nu zho 'thung pa man chad brdar du mi rung*/ spyir yang byis pa la dra ba dang brud pa 'tsham par bya/ rus pa so rtsigs su song na 'jam bcos bya/ zhom pa dang*/ gas pa dang*/ lha ba 'thems na sho re byas la rus pa brdar/ klad 'thems shes par byas la/ de nas drod kyis bcos/ dar dmar po dang pags pus dkri/ drod kyis bcos/ da ni rma lhog pa'i rtags bstan te/ g.yal mang ba dang*/ ltag mig blta ba dang*/ skabs su skyigs bu 'byung zhing yed yed po byas pa dang*/ bya rmyang byed snying 'dod pa dang*/ byad ser ba dang*/ mig sprin ser na klad pa'i steng na rnag yod/ tsag tsag byed na lha ba 'bros/ grang sib sib dang bring bring byed na lha ba 'bros/ 'dar ba dang lus grang sib sib 'dug na yang lha ba 'bros/ kha kha la skom dad che na yang ldog zug gzer che la mchu dmar na yang ldog zas yi gar mi 'ong na ldog 'dod chags spyad na ldog zhag bcu gsum lon nas ldog pa nyung ste/ ji srid log kyang gso ru rung ngo*// mtheb skor byas pas mi bzod pa'i san skyon yod/ rnag rtsa dmar ba dang*/ ser ba dang*/ sngo ba dang*/ sla ba dang*/ dri mi zhim pa dang*/ gshin dri chags na ngan/

rnag dkar la 'jam na bzang*/ nad pa na tsha chung na bzang*/ ro rgyab gzer ba dang*/ bshul sha na ba dang*/ tshigs gzhi na ba dang*/ pho kha 'khor ba dang*/ mkhris pa skyugs na 'chi/ log na bcos pa'i thabs la/ skyon gang byung ba'i ngos su sha dra/ rus pa yang brdar/ rtsa mig gi chu ser yang gdon/ rnag chu gang nas 'ong ba'i ngos nas rnag btsags/ lha mig stong pa sba bcad pa 'dra na de'i lha ba ded la khong nas chang dang sha gsar gyis bud/ slo dang sbang ma bsres pa'i lums bya/ drod tshil dang pags pas gtums/ rnag khur ma chad pa 'dra na ni sa cig na med par col le ba ste phal cher 'chi/ lha mig sngo sib sib song na yang 'chi/ lha mig nas rnag til 'bru tsam sngo tsig tsig byung na 'chi/ sha'u mgo che zhag gcig gnyis na skye na tsha ba'i bad ces bya ste brdar dgos so// klad pa'i rgya thog tu rnag lhung ba ni chag ste srubs zhig pa dang*/ rus pa chags pa ma tshor ba las 'byung ste/ nad pa khong lci la dang ga mi bde/ grang shum dang stong skyugs byed/ rkang lag bshal nas mig ser na klad pa'i rgya thog tu rnag lhung ba yin pas rgya bskyed la sha dra/ rus pa brdar/ 'og gi gdan la thug tsam na gzabs la srab mor brdar/ de nas rnag gi 'od blta ba ste/ lu gu nyal ba ltar skya khyil le 'dug na rnag gi 'od yin/ de'i thog tu brtol bas chog rma rtsi gong dang 'dra/ yang g.yas lta bu la phog pa na g.yon chag pa yang 'ong ste/ de'i thad kar rtag tu na ru 'ong*/ 'bur gyis byung na chag pa yin pas dras la brdar/ thang dang byi tshe mig tshod dang sbyar ro// klad pa tsha sbos chen po ni nyen che ste/ rtse'u chung la khrag lcogs tshad dbyung ngo*// de la sman dang kha zas drod can sbyar na 'chi/ lha ba skam bros la sman dang kha zas bsil du btang na 'chi/ bcos kyang skyed med pa'i nad pa spang*/ kha sha zha ba'i bcos thabs la spod sna tshogs dang*/ gla sgang dang*/ spang spos mar dang zho sbyar la lums dang dugs bya/

gting skyon che bas 'phral du 'chi bar bshad do// rma kha skam la lha ba byer ba rnag chu gting du song ba'i rtags yin/ yang na skam byer du 'gro ba yin te phal cher 'chi'o// rtsa byer la gang du byung bar gtar sreg dang bsil drod kyi dugs sna tshogs bya'o// rdul 'don ni/ da ni rtsa zil gyis mnan pa'i thabs la/ spyi bo'i gnam rten dang*/ dpral ba'i 'dzum rten dang*/ rna ltag g.yas g.yon na re re/ ltag pa'i chu mgo gnyis/ de rnams byar ram so mig ma tshor ba'am/ bcos ma legs na gnam rten shor na a wa dhū tī zhes bya ste/ srog rtsa dang rgyu ma la 'bab bo// rna ltag gi rtsa gnyis shor nas bshul sha la 'bab bas bshul sha rengs pas ltag pa dgye bor 'gro/ 'dzum rten shor na glo ba la 'bab/ rna ba'i mdun ngos kyi rtsa gnyis shor na pho mchin la 'bab/ ltag pa'i chu mgo'i rtsa gnyis shor na rkang pa la 'bab pas gzabs la bcos/ ma gzabs pa rnams la rtsa gnyen po rnams klu drag po dang 'dra'o// da ni sha'i rtsa zil gyis mnan te/ sha rtsa chen po la mtshon phog pa'am/ sha rus pas chod nas khrag ma chod na phying bsrab mkhregs kyis phying them bya/ de'i steng du dar 'jag gis rgya chings bya/ rtsa 'ol kha bsgyur/ phyis me btsas bsrung ngo*// rus pa'i rtsa zil gyis mnan pa ni/ khrag gson gshin sprod/ klad pa zil gyis mnan pa ni/ rna ba'i phyi nang na dpag bsam gyi yal ga bzhi yod pas de la rtse'u chung g.yas g.yon gtar pas thur du 'bros mi nus so// klad pa dang rus pa'i bar gyi chu ser thon nas rtsa yang 'bros mi nus so// sman dang zas kyis khong nas bus pas rnag dang chu ser gyen la rgyug cing rma gsher bar 'gyur/ zas kyi bye brag gis tsha grang cha mnyam/ gzer rtsa zil gyis mnan pa ni rtsa'i mtha' ma bskor te dbus lte bar bzhag btsan na gser gyi tel pas bsreg khong nas zas dang sman gyis bud do// man ngag 'di ni byams pa dang snying rje sngon du song bas bcos/

de lta ma yin pa'i sman pa ni gshin rje'i lag pa na mtshon thogs pa dang 'dra ste/ mi na ba na bar byed/ na ba 'chi bar byed pas sman mkhan byang chub sems dpa' snying rje dang ldan pas bya'o// man ngag 'di ni me tog gi nang nas sbrang rtsi dang 'dra'o// gso dpyad bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las mgo dpyad pad+ma dri med ces bya ba'i le'u rdzogs so// //'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di las 'phros pa'i mgo dpyad la ming 'dogs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod kyang*/ ngo bo 'di las med gsungs so// mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag nas byung ba'i sman sbyor dang*/ rgyud sde zab mo rnams nas bshad pa'i sngags dang*/ rdzas kyi sgo nas rang dang gzhan rjes su gzung ba'i thabs skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung las thos shing phyag len du mdzad pa rnams gdul bya man ngag gis dben pa rnams kyi don du phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas/ gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces mtshan du gsol ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //'dis sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
